programme.title: Mr. Bean, la série animée
programme.desc: Mr Bean est tellement absorbé par le nouveau drone de Mr Paliwal qu'il ne remarque pas qu'un voleur s'est emparé de sa voiture. Son voisin et lui sautent rapidement dans la voiture de Mr Paliwal et utilisent le drone pour suivre la voiture volée.

programme.title: Mr. Bean, la série animée
programme.desc: Irma traîne Mr Bean dans un centre commercial. Il y aperçoit un concours pour Menthe Gourmande. La queue étant trop longue, Mr Bean persuade Irma d'aller dans un studio de photos romantiques.

programme.title: Mr. Bean, la série animée
programme.desc: Lorsque Scrapper déchire Teddy avec ses griffes, Mr Bean l'emmène d'urgence à l'hôpital. Pendant qu'on soigne Teddy, Mr Bean est séduit par une autre peluche en vente dans le magasin.

programme.title: Zig et Sharko
programme.desc: Marina adore faire rire Sharko avec sa claquette-marionnette. Grisée par son talent comique, elle n'arrête pas de le déranger pendant ses activités. Le requin trouve ça pénible, mais n'ose pas le dire à son amie... jusqu'au moment où il craque.

programme.title: Zig et Sharko
programme.desc: En faisant du karaté, Marina perd une claquette qui atterrit dans la jungle. Sharko, Marina et la claquette restante partent à sa recherche. Seulement, Zig et Bernie attirent la sirène dans des pièges en faisant de fausses traces de claquettes.

programme.title: Zig et Sharko
programme.desc: Il ne reste plus qu'un seul yaourt pour Marina et Sharko. Par politesse, aucun des deux ne le prend. Seulement, Sharko ne résiste pas longtemps et pense le manger finalement en cachette.

programme.title: Zig et Sharko
programme.desc: Zig découvre que Sharko a une peur bleue des clowns. La hyène se déguise alors en clown et invite Marina à faire des gags avec elle pour mieux l'approcher et la croquer. Sharko doit alors dépasser sa peur pour protéger la sirène.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards
programme.desc: Après un soir de fête avec Jack, Oggy rentre chez lui au petit matin. Il n'a plus qu'une idée en tête : dormir ! Les cafards, déchaînés, sont bien décidés à l'empêcher de fermer l'œil. Un épisode à dormir debout.

programme.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches
programme.desc: Jack vient d'acheter une montgolfière qu'il s'empresse de gonfler chez Oggy. Les deux chats embarquent dans la nacelle pour un voyage d'autant plus mouvementé que les cafards ont piqué les commandes.

programme.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches
programme.desc: Quelle n'est pas la surprise d'Oggy de voir la balle qu'il vient d'acheter rebondir instantanément à travers toute la pièce en brisant tout sur son passage dans un sifflement de missile !

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards
programme.desc: Après avoir avalé une pilule piégée par les cancrelats, Oggy se transforme en blatte géante. L'œil hagard, il est d'abord complètement abattu par sa nouvelle apparence, puis il s'y habitue peu à peu et apprécie même de pouvoir marcher au plafond.

programme.title: Tiny Toons Looniversity
programme.desc: C'est la semaine des farces à Acme Looniversity, et les élèves montent la barre toujours plus haut.

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons
programme.desc: Porky a toutes les raisons de s'inquiéter : il doit impressionner une cliente influente s'il veut garder son café ouvert. Sylvestre mange Titi, qui croit alors avoir déménagé en Floride, et commence à explorer à fond son nouvel environnement.

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons
programme.desc: Elmer n'arrive pas à capturer Bugs. Ce dernier lui conseille de se moderniser. Elmer fabrique donc un robot pour attraper le lapin. Daffy devenu vendeur obstiné vient interrompre la nuit d'Elmer en lui proposant un produit révolutionnaire.

programme.title: Looney Tunes Cartoons
programme.desc: Daffy n'a pas de billet d'avion, alors pour embarquer, il se fait passer pour l'animal de soutien émotionnel de Porky. De son côté, Charlie Dog est de retour, et veut faire savoir qu'il est le meilleur chien de tous les temps.

programme.title: Scooby-Doo et compagnie
programme.desc: Sammy et Scooby-Doo ont hâte d'aller au camp d'entraînement d'accordéon de Weird Al. Mais en arrivant sur les lieux, ils découvrent qu'un mystérieux dinosaure a fait fuir tous les élèves...

programme.title: Quoi d'neuf Scooby Doo?
programme.desc: Scooby-Doo et la bande se rendent à Hong Kong. Le voyage se transforme en un nouveau mystère à résoudre pour les amis lorsqu'un énorme dragon du Nouvel An chinois prend soudainement vie.

programme.title: Mr. Bean, la série animée
programme.desc: Mr Bean repeint son salon, mais sa peur de la réaction de Mrs Wicket lui fait faire d'horribles cauchemars...

programme.title: Mr. Bean, la série animée
programme.desc: En découvrant toutes les possibilités d'un Smartphone, Mr Bean est impatient d'en posséder un. Après s'être rendu à la boutique de téléphonie mobile, il découvre un peu surpris qu'ils coûtent très cher et décide d'en fabriquer un lui-même.

programme.title: Mr. Bean, la série animée
programme.desc: Mr Bean essaye des vêtements chez Havlotts mais se laisse accidentellement enfermer dans le magasin pour la nuit. Et justement cette nuit-là, un voleur s'introduit dans la grande surface...

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: Les Docs poursuivent Lamput au zoo et capturent des animaux qu'ils transforment au labo à l'aide de leur nouvelle invention. Chat géant et singe volant s'élancent alors dans les allées du zoo.

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: Lamput se cache dans le port mais se fait malencontreusement embarquer avec Specs dans un porte conteneurs. A la suite d'une violente tempête Ils font naufrage sur une île déserte, et Specs va devoir accepter l'aide de Lamput pour s'en sortir.

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: Lamput a été capturé. Specs et Skinny n'ont plus grand chose à faire maintenant à part organiser des visites du laboratoire pour les écoliers, mais Tuzki va perdre ses camarades de classe et faire la rencontre du détenu tout orange.

programme.title: Lamput
programme.desc: Alors qu'il tente d'échapper aux Docs dans une petite ville de bord de mer, Lamput rencontre un monstre marin solitaire. Il tente de l'aider à se faire des amis, mais ses plans se retournent contre lui. Les habitants sont furieux.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards
programme.desc: Oggy travaille dans la boutique de tapis de Jack. Les cafards cherchent un tapis volant. Toutefois, au lieu d'un tapis volant, Oggy et les cafards trouvent un génie. Le génie est fantasque et il compte bien profiter de sa toute nouvelle liberté.

programme.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches
programme.desc: Paris 1900. Oggy et Jack poursuivent les cafards qui trouvent refuge dans les studios de Georges Méliès. Utilisant une fusée en carton-pâte prévu pour un film, ils décollent tous pour de vrai et se rendent sur la lune. Jack filme toute l'aventure.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards
programme.desc: Quand Charles Lindbergh décolle de New York pour tenter la première traversée de l'Atlantique sans escale, il embarque des passagers clandestins : Oggy et les cafards. Voulant secourir son cousin, Jack suit l'avion à la rame.

programme.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches
programme.desc: En 1700, les cafards piquent un autocuiseur que Jack vient d'acheter. A la suite d'une course-poursuite, l'engin atterrit sur une charrette et donne à Oggy l'idée de mettre au point le premier véhicule à combustion : la machine de Cugnot.

programme.title: Oggy et les cafards
programme.desc: Au Machu Pichu, grâce à une machine à fabriquer des éclipses artificielles, Joey arrive à contrôler le Dieu-Soleil et devient le chef tyrannique du village. Oggy arrivera-t-il à déjouer les plans des cafards et détrôner Joey ?

programme.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches
programme.desc: Au Machu Pichu, Oggy est chargé de protéger les offrandes au temple. Les cafards font équipe avec un conquistador fou : il les aide à atteindre les offrandes de l'idole et à se débarrasser d'Oggy, en échange, il aura la statuette en or du temple.

programme.title: Grizzy et les Lemmings
programme.desc: En cherchant à éviter le hors-bord des Lemmings, Grizzy perce son matelas pneumatique, qui l'éjecte dans une grotte cachée. Il y trouve une conque décorée de symboles maoris qui a le pouvoir de contrôler une baleine. Grizzy revient chevauchant fièrement son cétacé et chasse les Lemmings de son coin tranquille. Cependant, l'imagination des Lemmings va de pair avec la taille de ce potentiel nouveau compagnon de jeu !

programme.title: Grizzy et les Lemmings
programme.desc: Grizzy et les Lemmings rencontrent un ourson polaire en pleurs, qu'ils doivent calmer pour pouvoir reprendre leur bataille de nourriture.

programme.title: Grizzy et les Lemmings
programme.desc: Une météorite tombe non loin de la cabane. Alors que les Lemmings font de la luge sur un couvercle métallique, leur luge est attirée brusquement vers la roche extraterrestre.

programme.title: Grizzy et les Lemmings
programme.desc: Les lemmings ont mis en place un long enchaînement de dominos dans la cabane, qui se termine par de gigantesques blocs de glace et une fusée à l'extérieur. Las de ne pas pouvoir trouver le calme qu'il espère, Grizzy sabote le parcours.

programme.title: Grizzy et les Lemmings
programme.desc: Les lemmings découvrent un un raton préhistorique à dents de sabre congelé dans un bloc de glace. Les lemmings décident alors de le domestiquer comme un chaton. Or, c'est une vraie tornade.

programme.title: Mr. Bean, la série animée
programme.desc: Un œuf d'oiseau a été découvert sur le toit de Mr Bean qui décide alors de l'élever.

programme.title: Mr. Bean, la série animée

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes.

programme.title: Let's Make a Deal
programme.desc: CBS adds to its daytime game-show lineup with an updated version of the classic TV show of the 1960s, filmed in Los Angeles. Hosted by comic/singer/actor Wayne Brady, contestants -- often dressed in a wide variety of original costumes -- will still compete for money and prizes by striking wacky deals. Jonathan Mangum is the show's announcer, and Monty Hall, arguably the best-known host of the earlier version of the show, is listed among the new show's creative consultants. The program won a Daytime Creative Arts Emmy Award for Outstanding Original Song in 2014 for "30,000 Reasons to Love Me," composed by Cat Gray and performed by Wayne Brady.

programme.title: Hudson & Rex

programme.title: CSI: Miami

programme.desc: Hundidos por la rutina diaria, un matrimonio que vive en una apacible zona residencial intenta reavivar la pasión visitando un pequeño restaurante que está de moda en Manhattan. Ellos reciben mucho más de lo que esperaban cuando un caso de identidad equivocada los lleva a vivir una aventura insólita en la que tendrán que lidiar con policías corruptos, un jefe de la mafia y un alocado taxista.

programme.title: Miamor perdido

programme.title: La gran aventura de los Lunnis y el libro mágico
programme.desc: La fantasía está en peligro. El malvado Crudo ha descubierto la forma de terminar con el Libro Mágico, que contiene todas las historias inventadas por la humanidad. Una niña de 9 años es la elegida para salvarla con la ayuda de sus amigos los Lunnis.

programme.title: Un niñero sinvergüenza

programme.desc: Un comediante de stand-up queda atrapado en medio de dos alocados hermanos que se disputan el control del negocio familiar.

programme.title: Moulin Rouge, amor en rojo
programme.desc: Satine, la estrella más rutilante del Moulin Rouge, encandila a toda la ciudad con sus bailes llenos de sensualidad. Atrapada entre el amor de dos hombres, un joven escritor y un duque, mientras lucha por hacer realidad su sueño de ser actriz.

programme.title: Emma
programme.desc: Emma Woodhouse es una joven inglesa que se ocupa de las relaciones de quienes la rodean, aunque a veces de una manera un tanto entrometida.

programme.title: Loco corazón
programme.desc: Tras diversos fracasos matrimoniales, y sumido en una carrera en pleno declive, el músico de country Bad Blake se refugia en el alcohol. Cuando parece que ya no hay salvación para él, Jean irrumpe en su vida y, con ella, una esperanza.

programme.title: Ladrona de libros
programme.desc: En la Alemania de la era nazi, el Ángel de la Muerte narra la historia de una niña adoptada, quien aprende a leer gracias a su padre. Ella se hace amiga de un joven judío, cuyos padres están ocultando.

programme.title: Ophelia
programme.desc: Ophelia es una joven impetuosa que forma parte de las personas de confianza de la reina Gertrudis en el palacio de Elsinore. Su personalidad no pasa desapercibida ante los ojos del príncipe Hamlet, a quien conquista rápidamente. Después del asesinato del rey, el príncipe se ve desbordado por una sed implacable de venganza, y Ophelia deberá contener a las altas esferas del poder danés.

programme.title: Sweetheart
programme.desc: Un náufrago que se encuentra en una isla desierta debe luchar contra una fuerza maligna que se presenta cada noche.

programme.title: It
programme.desc: In 1960, seven preteen outcasts fight an evil demon that poses as a child-killing clown. Thirty years later, they reunite to stop the demon once and for all when it returns to their hometown.

programme.title: It
programme.desc: Seven young outcasts in Derry, Maine, are about to face their worst nightmare -- an ancient, shape-shifting evil that emerges from the sewer every 27 years to prey on the town's children. Banding together over the course of one horrifying summer, the friends must overcome their own personal fears to battle the murderous, bloodthirsty clown known as Pennywise.

programme.title: It: Chapter Two
programme.desc: Defeated by members of the Losers' Club, the evil clown Pennywise returns 27 years later to terrorize the town of Derry, Maine, once again. Now adults, the childhood friends have long since gone their separate ways. But when people start disappearing, Mike Hanlon calls the others home for one final stand. Damaged by scars from the past, the united Losers must conquer their deepest fears to destroy the shape-shifting Pennywise -- now more powerful than ever.

programme.title: The Devil's Rejects
programme.desc: After a raid on the rural home of the psychopathic Firefly family, two members of the clan, Otis (Bill Moseley) and Baby (Sheri Moon Zombie), manage to flee the scene. Heading to a remote desert motel, the killers reunite with Baby's father, Capt. Spaulding (Sid Haig), who is equally demented and intent on maintaining their murder spree. While the trio continues to torment and kill various victims, the vengeful Sheriff Wydell (William Forsythe) slowly closes in on them.

programme.title: The Man
programme.desc: Seeking the gunrunners who killed his partner, undercover cop Derrick Vann (Samuel L. Jackson) sets up a sting. He arranges to meet an arms dealer at a diner, where he'll be the only one reading USA Today. But dentist Andy Fiddler (Eugene Levy), who's in Detroit for a conference, is there reading the same paper, and the dealer mistakes him for Vann and sets up the deal. When Vann realizes this, he drags the baffled Andy into the operation, forcing him to pose as the fake buyer.

programme.title: The Family
programme.desc: After ratting out his Mafia cohorts, Giovanni Manzoni (Robert De Niro) and his family enter the Witness Protection Program and relocate to a French town. Despite the best efforts of their handler (Tommy Lee Jones) to keep them in line, Giovanni (now called Fred Blake), his wife (Michelle Pfeiffer) and children (Dianna Agron, John D'Leo) can't help but resort to doing things the "family" way. However, their dependence on such old habits places everyone in danger from vengeful mobsters.

programme.title: Fargo
programme.desc: "Fargo" is a reality-based crime drama set in Minnesota in 1987. Jerry Lundegaard (William H. Macy) is a car salesman in Minneapolis who has gotten himself into debt and is so desperate for money that he hires two thugs (Steve Buscemi), (Peter Stormare) to kidnap his own wife. Jerry will collect the ransom from her wealthy father (Harve Presnell), paying the thugs a small portion and keeping the rest to satisfy his debts. The scheme collapses when the thugs shoot a state trooper.

programme.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
programme.desc: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages.

programme.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
programme.desc: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former baby sitter Laurie Strode (Jamie Lee Curtis) finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason.

programme.title: Halloween: Resurrection
programme.desc: He's back for more... When a group of teens win a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. But things go frightfully wrong and the game turns into a struggle to make it out of the house alive.

programme.title: Maze Runner: The Death Cure
programme.desc: Thomas leads some escaped Gladers on their final and most dangerous mission yet. To save their friends, they must break into the legendary Last City, a WCKD-controlled labyrinth that may turn out to be the deadliest maze of all. Anyone who makes it out alive will get answers to the questions that the Gladers have been asking since they arrived in the maze.

programme.title: War for the Planet of the Apes
programme.desc: Caesar (Andy Serkis) and his apes are forced into a deadly conflict with an army of humans led by a ruthless colonel (Woody Harrelson). After the apes suffer unimaginable losses, Caesar wrestles with his darker instincts and begins his own mythic quest to avenge his kind. As the journey finally brings them face to face, Caesar and the colonel are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of both of their species and the future of the planet.

programme.title: The Hole in the Ground
programme.desc: One night, Sarah's young son disappears into the woods behind their rural home. When he returns, he looks the same, but his behavior grows increasingly disturbing. Sarah begins to believe that the boy who returned may not be her son at all.

programme.title: The Watch
programme.desc: In Glenview, Ohio, four pals, Evan, Bob, Franklin and Jamarcus, form a neighborhood watch group. Armed with flashlights, walkie-talkies and spiffy new jackets, the guys try to take their mission seriously, even if they spend a little time goofing off now and then. But when they discover aliens living among them and no one believes their story, they learn that they have to kick things up a notch to save the world from annihilation.

programme.title: The Post
programme.desc: Katharine Graham is the first female publisher of a major American newspaper -- The Washington Post. With help from editor Ben Bradlee, Graham races to catch up with The New York Times to expose a massive cover-up of government secrets that spans three decades and four U.S. presidents. Together, they must overcome their differences as they risk their careers -- and very freedom -- to help bring long-buried truths to light.

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: Now that Chris and his girlfriend, Rose, have reached the meet-the-parents milestone of dating, she invites him for a weekend getaway with Missy and Dean. At first, Chris reads the family's overly accommodating behavior as nervous attempts to deal with their daughter's interracial relationship, but as the weekend progresses, a series of increasingly disturbing discoveries leads him to a truth that he never could have imagined.

programme.title: It's Complicated
programme.desc: Jane (Meryl Streep), a successful restaurateur, has been divorced from Jake (Alec Baldwin) for many years, although they remain friends. When an innocent meal together turns into an affair, Jane finds that she is the other woman in the now-remarried Jake's life. Meanwhile, Adam (Steve Martin), an architect hired to remodel her kitchen, is still stinging from his own divorce. He finds himself falling in love with Jane but soon realizes that he has become part of a triangle.

programme.title: Love Happens
programme.desc: Dr. Burke Ryan (Aaron Eckhart) is a self-help guru who is on the verge of a lucrative multimedia deal. But there's a problem: though he advises his patients to confront their pain, Burke has never come to terms with his wife's death. Eloise Chandler (Jennifer Aniston) has had enough of men and dating, and is busy concentrating on her floral business. When they meet, Burke and Eloise feel an instant attraction, but wonder if they'll be able to let go of their painful pasts and embrace the future.

programme.title: The Mountain Between Us
programme.desc: Stranded on a mountain after a tragic plane crash, two strangers must work together to endure the extreme elements of the remote, snow-covered terrain. Realizing that help is not on the way, they embark on a perilous journey across hundreds of miles of wilderness, pushing each other to survive and discovering their inner strength.

programme.title: Love & Mercy
programme.desc: In the late 1960s, the Beach Boys' Brian Wilson stops touring, produces "Pet Sounds" and begins to lose his grip on reality. By the 1980s, Wilson, under the sway of a controlling therapist, finds a savior in Melinda Ledbetter.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself.

programme.title: The Art of Getting By
programme.desc: George (Freddie Highmore) is a senior at a posh Manhattan prep school, but his disaffected attitude leaves little room for toeing the line. He'd rather doodle and read philosophy, and he strenuously avoids his parents (Rita Wilson, Sam Robards) whenever possible. Unfortunately, George's attitude is endangering his chances of graduating. Then he meets Sally (Emma Roberts). George finds himself falling in love with her, but an older artist (Michael Angarano) adds a complication to the mix.

programme.title: A Thousand Words
programme.desc: Jack McCall (Eddie Murphy) is a selfish literary agent whose fast-talking ways allow him to close any deal. His next target is New Age guru Dr. Sinja (Cliff Curtis), but the savvy doctor sees right through Jack. A magical tree appears in Jack's yard, and, according to Dr. Sinja, the tree and Jack are connected; every time Jack says a word, a leaf falls from the tree. When the last leaf drops, Jack will die. With just a thousand leaves left, Jack must learn to curb his speech, or he's a goner.

programme.title: Spare Parts
programme.desc: With the help of their high school's newest teacher (George Lopez), four Hispanic students form a robotics club. Although they have no experience, the youths set their sights on a national robotics contest. With $800 and parts scavenged from old cars, they build a robot and compete against reigning champion MIT. Along the way, the students learn not only how to build a robot but something far more important: how to forge bonds that will last a lifetime.

programme.title: We Live in Time
programme.desc: A surprise encounter brings together a couple, changing the course of their lives. Challenged by the limits of time, they learn to cherish each moment of their decade-spanning and movingly rare love story.

programme.title: Janet Planet
programme.desc: Enthralled by her own imagination, 11-year-old Lacy spends the long summer at home with her mother and three strangers.

programme.title: Knox Goes Away
programme.desc: Diagnosed with a rapidly evolving form of dementia, a contract killer gets the chance to redeem himself by saving the life of his estranged son.

programme.title: Queer
programme.desc: Lee, a solitary American in Mexico City, falls for a beautiful, elusive former soldier. Journeying together into the jungle, Lee sees, for the first time, the possibility of an intimate and infinite love.

programme.title: Unlocked
programme.desc: After failing to apprehend the terrorist behind a Paris attack that claimed dozens of lives, CIA agent Alice Racine is forced to live in London as a caseworker. Her mentor unexpectedly calls her back into action when the CIA discovers that another attack is imminent. Alice soon learns that the classified information she's uncovered has been compromised. Running for her life, she turns to a former soldier to help her prevent a lethal biological attack on the citizens of London.

programme.title: The Belko Experiment
programme.desc: An ordinary day at the office becomes a horrific quest for survival when 80 employees at the Belko Corp. in Bogotá, Colombia, learn that they are pawns in a deadly game. Trapped inside their building, a voice over an intercom tells the frightened staffers that two workers must be killed within 30 minutes. When another ultimatum follows, friends become enemies and new alliances take shape, as only the strongest will remain alive at the end.

programme.title: Papillon
programme.desc: Convicted murderer Henri Charriere (Steve McQueen), known as "Papillon" for his butterfly chest tattoo, is transported to French Guiana to serve his sentence in a work camp. Determined to escape, Papillon forms an unlikely relationship with the frail but notorious forger Louis Dega (Dustin Hoffman), who reluctantly joins in the attempt. Despite the harshness of solitary confinement, brutal conditions and constant threats of betrayal, Papillon leads a desperate escape off the island.

programme.title: Yogi Bear
programme.desc: Yogi and his sidekick, Boo Boo, are Jellystone Park's most-notorious troublemakers, hatching countless schemes to separate park visitors from their vittles. Standing in the way of picnic perfection is their long-suffering nemesis, Ranger Smith. But when Mayor Brown announces his plans to sell Jellystone Park to loggers, Yogi, Boo Boo and Ranger Smith must join forces to save their beloved campground from closing forever.

programme.title: The Three Stooges
programme.desc: Left on the doorstep of an orphanage run by nuns, three newborn knuckleheads grow up to be finger-poking, nyuk-nyuking janitors named Larry (Sean Hayes), Curly (Will Sasso) and Moe (Chris Diamantopoulos). When they learn that financial problems will soon force the only home they've ever known to close, the trio sets out to raise $830,000 in one month. Out in the world for the very first time, the three innocent bumblers become embroiled in a murder plot and find stardom on a TV reality show.

programme.title: The Man Who Invented Christmas
programme.desc: In 1843 London, author Charles Dickens finds himself in financial trouble after writing three unsuccessful novels in a row. Desperate for a hit, Dickens relies on real-life inspiration and his vivid imagination to bring Ebenezer Scrooge, Tiny Tim and other classic characters to life in A Christmas Carol, forever changing the holiday season into the celebration known today.

programme.title: Pan
programme.desc: Living a bleak existence at a London orphanage, 12-year-old Peter finds himself whisked away to the fantastical world of Neverland. Adventure awaits as he meets new friend James Hook and the warrior Tiger Lily. They must band together to save Neverland from the ruthless pirate Blackbeard.

programme.title: Son of the Mask
programme.desc: A cartoonist and family man, Tim Avery (Jamie Kennedy) lives a peaceful existence with his wife, Tonya (Traylor Howard), as well as their infant son and dog. When the curious canine finds a mask with mystical properties, both dog and baby create chaos with its powers. While Tim and Tonya try to contain the damage, the sly Norse god Loki (Alan Cumming) comes looking for the artifact, resulting in more mishaps that ultimately incur the wrath of the deity's powerful father, Odin (Bob Hoskins).

programme.title: Waitress: The Musical
programme.desc: Jenna Hunterson is a waitress and expert pie maker stuck in a small town and a loveless marriage. When a baking contest offers her a chance at escape, Jenna fights to reclaim part of herself.

programme.title: The Peanut Butter Falcon
programme.desc: After running away from a residential nursing home to pursue his dream of becoming a pro wrestler, a man who has Down syndrome befriends an outlaw who becomes his coach and ally.

programme.title: Chasing Mavericks
programme.desc: When 15-year-old surfing phenomenon Jay Moriarty discovers that the mythic Mavericks surf break, one of the biggest waves on Earth, actually exists near his California home, he becomes determined to conquer it. Jay enlists the aid of local surfing legend Frosty Hesson to train him to ride the Mavericks and live to tell about it. As Jay and Frosty carry on their quest to achieve the impossible, they develop a unique friendship that transforms both their lives.

programme.title: Brian Banks
programme.desc: The inspirational true story of Brian Banks, an all-American high school football star who finds his life upended when he's wrongly convicted of a crime he didn't commit. Despite the lack of evidence, Banks gets railroaded through a broken justice system and sentenced to a decade of prison and probation. Years later, with the support of Justin Brooks and the California Innocence Project, Banks fights to reclaim his life and fulfill his dreams of playing in the NFL.

programme.title: Leave No Trace
programme.desc: A father and daughter live a perfect but mysterious existence in Forest Park, a beautiful nature reserve near Portland, Ore., rarely making contact with the world. But when a small mistake tips them off to authorities, they are sent on an increasingly erratic journey in search of a place to call their own.

programme.title: Murder on the Orient Express
programme.desc: A lavish trip through Europe quickly unfolds into a race against time to solve a murder aboard a train. When an avalanche stops the Orient Express dead in its tracks, the world's greatest detective -- Hercule Poirot -- arrives to interrogate all passengers and search for clues before the killer can strike again.

programme.title: Open Water
programme.desc: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller.

programme.title: Shot Caller
programme.desc: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang.

programme.title: Gifted
programme.desc: Frank Adler (Chris Evans) is a single man raising a child prodigy - his spirited young niece Mary (Mckenna Grace) - in a coastal town in Florida. Frank's plans for a normal school life for Mary are foiled when the 7-year-old's mathematical abilities come to the attention of Frank's formidable mother, Evelyn (Lindsay Duncan), whose plans for her granddaughter threaten to separate Frank and Mary.

programme.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
programme.desc: Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian.

programme.title: Ruby Sparks
programme.desc: Young author Calvin Weir-Fields (Paul Dano), once a literary darling, is having trouble composing his next novel. Following a therapist's advice, Calvin pulls out an old manual typewriter and creates a vivacious, flame-haired woman he dubs Ruby Sparks (Zoe Kazan). Overnight, Ruby leaps from the page into Calvin's home as a real flesh-and-blood woman. And, what's more, she's unaware that she's actually a fictional character and that her actions and feelings are dictated by whatever Calvin writes.

programme.title: Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom
programme.desc: After failing to defeat Aquaman the first time, Black Manta wields the power of the mythic Black Trident to unleash an ancient and malevolent force. Hoping to end his reign of terror, Aquaman forges an unlikely alliance with his brother, Orm, the former king of Atlantis. Setting aside their differences, they join forces to protect their kingdom and save the world from irreversible destruction.

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities.

programme.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
programme.desc: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world.

programme.title: The Flash
programme.desc: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for.

programme.title: Show Dogs
programme.desc: After a failed attempt to recover a stolen baby panda, police dog Max reluctantly teams up with a human FBI agent named Frank. A hot tip leads Max and Frank to Las Vegas for the world's most exclusive dog show. To find the panda, Max goes under cover as a contestant to get the lowdown from his fellow canines. With help from their new friends, the crime-fighting duo must now foil another kidnapping plot and rescue other valuable animals from a gang of greedy smugglers.

programme.title: Sound of My Voice
programme.desc: California couple Peter (Christopher Denham) and Lorna (Nicole Vicius) set out to make a documentary meant to expose a charismatic cult leader named Maggie (Brit Marling) as a fraud. Maggie claims to be from the year 2054 and is seemingly allergic to almost everything in her environment; she lives in a basement, subsisting on canned oxygen, homegrown food and the blood of her acolytes. Though at first, Peter and Lorna are adamant that Maggie is a fake, they both soon fall under her spell.

programme.title: We Are Your Friends
programme.desc: Young Cole Carter (Zac Efron) dreams of hitting the big time as a Hollywood disc jockey, spending his days and nights hanging with buddies and working on the one track that will set the world on fire. Opportunity comes knocking when he meets James Reed, a charismatic DJ who takes the 23-year-old under his wing. Soon, his seemingly clear path to success gets complicated when he starts falling for his mentor's girlfriend, jeopardizing his new friendship and the future he seems destined to fulfill.

programme.title: The Disaster Artist
programme.desc: The incredible true story of aspiring filmmaker and Hollywood outsider Tommy Wiseau as he and his best friend defiantly pursue their dreams and embark on the hilarious odyssey of making the now-infamous, cult classic "The Room."

programme.title: Skiptrace
programme.desc: A detective from Hong Kong teams up with an American gambler to battle a Chinese criminal.

programme.title: Beirut
programme.desc: In the 1980s Beirut, Mason Skiles is a former U.S. diplomat who is called back into service to save a colleague from the group that is possibly responsible for his own family's death. Meanwhile, a CIA field agent who is working undercover at the American embassy is tasked with keeping Mason alive and ensuring that the mission is a success.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat Legends: Scorpion's Revenge
programme.desc: The champions of Outworld and Earthrealm fight to the death in a brutal tournament that determines the fate of Earth.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat Legends: Battle of the Realms
programme.desc: The heroes must travel to Outworld to defend Earthrealm as Scorpion searches for the ancient Kamidogu before it's used to resurrect the One Being.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat Legends: Snow Blind
programme.desc: When Kano and Black Dragon mercenaries become determined to take over Earthrealm, undisciplined Kenshi seeks tutelage from retired Kuai Liang to stop Kano from decimating all of Earthrealm.

programme.title: Mortal Kombat Legends: Cage Match
programme.desc: Action superstar Johnny Cage squares off against a sinister secret society that's plotting a nefarious scheme. However, the brutal fight against the bloodthirsty warriors of the Netherrealm is just the beginning.

programme.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
programme.desc: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages.

programme.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
programme.desc: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former baby sitter Laurie Strode (Jamie Lee Curtis) finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason.

programme.title: Halloween: Resurrection
programme.desc: He's back for more... When a group of teens win a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. But things go frightfully wrong and the game turns into a struggle to make it out of the house alive.

programme.title: Maze Runner: The Death Cure
programme.desc: Thomas leads some escaped Gladers on their final and most dangerous mission yet. To save their friends, they must break into the legendary Last City, a WCKD-controlled labyrinth that may turn out to be the deadliest maze of all. Anyone who makes it out alive will get answers to the questions that the Gladers have been asking since they arrived in the maze.

programme.title: Get Out
programme.desc: Now that Chris and his girlfriend, Rose, have reached the meet-the-parents milestone of dating, she invites him for a weekend getaway with Missy and Dean. At first, Chris reads the family's overly accommodating behavior as nervous attempts to deal with their daughter's interracial relationship, but as the weekend progresses, a series of increasingly disturbing discoveries leads him to a truth that he never could have imagined.

programme.title: Survivre
programme.desc: Une catastrophe bouleverse la planète : les pôles magnétiques de la Terre se sont inversés. Les océans ont anéanti les continents, laissant derrière eux un vaste désert. Dans ce monde ravagé, une famille doit lutter pour sa survie. Quand les pôles s'inverseront à nouveau, il sera trop tard.

programme.title: Mange
programme.desc: Jill est escort girl. Lorsqu'elle rencontre Alex qui la paye pour la regarder manger, c'est son propre désir qui se transforme et vire à l'obsession.

programme.title: Le dernier gang
programme.desc: Des petits larcins sur les bancs de Belleville aux braquages surmédiatisés des plus grandes banques parisiennes, l'ascension spectaculaire de Simon et de sa bande. Ceux-ci sont capables de vider une série de coffres sous le nez d'une police désorientée par leur audace tranquille. Cependant, il leur faut compter avec Milan, un flic acharné à les faire tomber depuis leurs premiers coups dans le quartier.

programme.title: Les enquêtes du Département V : L'effet papillon
programme.desc: Le jeune Marco, un sans-abri, découvre un jour un cadavre. Il comprend que les auteurs du crime appartiennent au gang de son oncle. Arrêté par la police, il refuse d'expliquer comment il s'est retrouvé avec les papiers d'un policier disparu après avoir été accusé puis relaxé pour agressions pédophiles. Le commissaire Morck, en charge de l'affaire, comprend que Marco pourrait détenir des informations importantes. Il n'obtient rien du sans-abri qui finit par prendre la fuite.

programme.title: Moonfall
programme.desc: Une force mystérieuse provoque la chute de la Lune, qui menace de s'écraser sur la Terre. L'ancienne astronaute, Jo Fowler, pense avoir la solution pour empêcher cette catastrophe, mais peu de gens croient en elle. Seuls un astronaute qu'elle a connu autrefois, Brian Harper, et un théoricien du complot, K.C. Houseman sont de son côté. Le trio va alors tenter une mission impossible dans l'espace.

programme.title: Le transporteur
programme.desc: Frank, un as du volant, convoie des colis douteux sans poser de questions. Il respecte les règles d'or du Milieu, n'ouvre jamais les colis, ne se fait jamais attraper et entretient des rapports très courtois avec Tarconi, un policier qui aimerait l'arrêter. Un jour, il ouvre le sac qu'il doit livrer, posé dans son coffre, et découvre une jeune femme prénommée Lai. Le convoyeur remplit son contrat mais son employeur, s'apercevant de l'infraction, décide de lui faire payer son audace.

programme.title: En plein feu
programme.desc: Alors qu'un incendie de forêt ravage la région depuis désormais des semaines, Simon et son père Joseph doivent quitter leur maison et décident de prendre la route suite aux inquiétantes alertes d'évacuation. Or, le vent se lève, rendant le feu impossible à contrôler. Prisonniers de leur véhicule et seuls dans une forêt transformée en brasier géant, Simon et Joseph se demandent s'ils réussiront à s'en sortir.

programme.title: Rambo III
programme.desc: John Rambo est de retour de sa dernière mission au Viêtnam. Discrètement retiré en Thaïlande, il vit tranquillement, en compagnie de moines bouddhistes. Il espère ainsi se tenir à l'écart de l'univers de violence qui a trop longtemps été le sien. Un jour, cependant, le héros fatigué reçoit la visite du colonel Trautman, son instructeur et père spirituel, qui lui demande de lui prêter main-forte une fois encore.

programme.title: Millénium : ce qui ne me tue pas
programme.desc: Hacker asociale, Lisbeth Salander vient en aide aux femmes en punissant les hommes qui les violentent. Un jour, un ami programmeur la charge de voler un logiciel nommé Firefall, qui permet d'accéder aux codes nucléaires du monde entier. Elle parvient à le récupérer sur les serveurs de la NSA, mais attire l'attention d'Edwin, un agent américain. Lisbeth se trouve alors prise en chasse par différentes organisations concurrentes. Après la Suédoise Noomi Rapace puis l'Américaine Rooney Mara, c'est.

programme.title: Amants
programme.desc: Lisa et Simon sont inséparables. Ils sont passionnés l'un par l'autre depuis leur adolescence. Une tragédie survient, provoquée par les activités criminelles de Simon. Il est en danger et s'enfuit. Sans Lisa. Elle attend en vain des nouvelles de lui. Trois ans plus tard, elle est mariée à Léo lorsque leurs chemins se croisent à nouveau sur une île de l'océan Indien.

programme.title: Elle
programme.desc: Alors que Michèle, PDG d'une société de jeux vidéo, est agressée chez elle par un mystérieux inconnu, elle refuse de laisser l'événement perturber la discipline qu'elle s'impose au quotidien. C'est avec un calme glacial qu'elle organise le chaos qui l'entoure et mène de front une série de crises. Inébranlable, elle décide de faire face à son viol avec le même sang-froid, avant de comprendre que son agresseur n'en a pas fini avec elle.

programme.title: Hostiles
programme.desc: En 1892, le capitaine de cavalerie Joseph Blocker, ancien héros de guerre devenu gardien de prison, est contraint d'escorter Yellow Hawk, chef de guerre Cheyenne mourant, sur ses anciennes terres tribales. Peu après avoir pris la route, ils rencontrent Rosalee Quaid. Seule rescapée du massacre de sa famille par les Comanches, la jeune femme traumatisée se joint à eux. Sur le chemin qui va les conduire du Nouveau-Mexique au Montana, les anciens ennemis vont devoir faire preuve de solidarité.

programme.title: The Homesman
programme.desc: En 1854, trois femmes ayant perdu la raison sont confiées à Mary Bee Cuddy, une pionnière forte et indépendante originaire du Nebraska. Sur sa route vers l'Iowa, où ces femmes pourront trouver refuge, elle croise le chemin de George Briggs, un rustre vagabond qu'elle sauve d'une mort imminente. Ils décident de s'associer afin de faire face, ensemble, à la rudesse et aux dangers qui sévissent dans les vastes étendues de la frontière.

programme.title: L'amour en limousine
programme.desc: Ce programme pornographique est réservé à un public adulte averti de plus de 18 ans.

programme.title: Guante blanco
programme.desc: Una historia diferente de policías y ladrones, donde Mario es jefe de una banda y Bernardo es policía. Sin perder de vista la intriga propia de las series policíacas, la serie concede especial importancia a las relaciones personales y familiares.

programme.title: Guante blanco
programme.desc: Una historia diferente de policías y ladrones, donde Mario es jefe de una banda y Bernardo es policía. Sin perder de vista la intriga propia de las series policíacas, la serie concede especial importancia a las relaciones personales y familiares.

programme.title: Bob Esponja
programme.desc: Bob quiere ganar a Calamardo en la carrera de caracoles, por eso entrena a su caracol, Gary, día y noche. Además, el Sr. Cangrejo está preocupado porque se hace mayor. Para demostrar que no es un viejo anticuado se apunta a una fiesta.

programme.title: Cleo
programme.desc: Cleo y sus amigos visitan en Lanzarote una escuela de buceo muy especial donde aprenderán las pautas básicas para bucear y comunicarse bajo el agua.

programme.title: Slugterra: Ascension
programme.desc: La salida de la caverna, donde sus mechas y el resto de sus babosas están esperando, ahora está a la vista. Eli, Trixie y sus babosas tendrán que ser muy silenciosas y cuidadosas para evitar ser detectadas.

programme.title: Slugterra: Ascension
programme.desc: Con sus enemigos atrapados, Eli y Trixie están libres para reunirse con sus mechas y el resto de sus babosas. ¡Pero la batalla aún no ha terminado! Con solo unas pocas de sus babosas reactivadas, ¿será suficiente?

programme.title: Slugterra
programme.desc: Eli junto a sus amigos Koro, Trixie y Pronto, tratará de recuperar el slug que cedió a cambios de piezas y recambios. Pero este ha sido vendido al Dr. Blakk junto a otros slugs, y tendrán que enfrentarse a este y sus secuaces si quieren recuperarlo.

programme.title: Polinópolis
programme.desc: El nuevo videojuego de moda ya está a la venta, y Milo lo tiene que conseguir sea como sea. Después de romper la hucha y darse cuenta de que no se lo puede comprar de ninguna de las maneras, decide que tiene que ganar dinero.

programme.title: Polinópolis
programme.desc: Después de comerse todos los dulces a su alcance durante el cumpleaños de su prima, Zabo se encuentra fatal. El diagnóstico del médico está claro: síndrome del hígado dulce. La solución: prohibido comer azúcar durante cinco días.

programme.title: Polinópolis
programme.desc: El grupo decide formar una banda musical a espaldas de Milo. Su talento musical es completamente nulo. Cuando Milo se entera, decide formar su propia banda.

programme.title: Polinópolis
programme.desc: Después de ser ridiculizada delante de todo el mundo, en un partido amistoso de ping-pong contra Jíbara, Uma decide apuntarse al torneo de Polinopolis para volver a jugar contra ella y poder ganarla.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey está impresionada con todas las opciones disponibles en el mercadillo para gastar los cinco dólares que le dio el ratoncito Pérez. Sin embargo, es más difícil de lo que parece hacer la compra perfecta.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Los Heeler juegan una partida de Bus con papá como conductor, mamá como pasajera normal y Bluey y Bingo como abuelas.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bingo y Bluey se turnan para ser la reina y su mayordomo. Cuando ambas quieren ser mayordomo, mamá es coronada después del breve período caótico en que papá fue reina.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Es momento de que Bluey y Bingo salgan del baño. Pero papá ha decidido no decirles qué hacer y se ve envuelto en un juego de Tienda de Hamburguesas.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bluey es la maestra de ceremonias en un juego de circo con sus amigos, pero Hércules quiere jugar con su moto. Afortunadamente, Bluey tiene una solución para mantener felices a todos.

programme.title: Marvel Spidey y su superequipo
programme.desc: Cuando las pociones de Lizard lo convierten en un gigante, trata de apoderarse de la Torre Stark y enfrenta a un Spidey gigante. Rhino se apodera de la gema de White Tiger y genera problemas animales en la ciudad.

programme.title: La casa de Mickey Mouse +
programme.desc: Mickey y sus amigos dan la bienvenida a todos al club para vivir nuevas aventuras llenas de música, risas y sorpresas.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Bingo está jugando al malhumor con papá: se queda sobre sus pies mientras él recorre la casa vigilando todo lo que hace Bingo y provocando el caos.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: Cuando Chloe intenta enseñarle a su padre a improvisar y jugar el juego del Pulpo de Bluey en casa, a él le resulta difícil de entender hasta que se dan cuenta de que pueden jugarlo a su manera.

programme.title: Peppa Pig
programme.desc: Unos personajes simpáticos llenos de energía y actividad donde predomina el compañerismo. Peppa, su familia y amigos encarnan valores que sirven de ejemplo a los más pequeños como el amor, la solidaridad, el diálogo familiar entre otros. Cada uno de los personajes es un tipo de animal diferente con un apellido que coincide con el tipo de animal que cada uno es. Aunque son parecidos a los humanos en muchos aspectos, los personajes siguen mostrando las características de su especie, como la familia Conejo que está obsesionada con las zanahorias.

programme.title: Petronix
programme.desc: Cuando la Jefa de pistas captura a un par de búhos, Paul-E necesita aprender el arte del sigilo para salvarlos.

programme.title: Petronix
programme.desc: Matt está tan decidido en sus propias ideas que no tiene en cuanta la ingeniosa idea de Tim de usar a Barney como aliado en un rescate de armiños, poniendo así en peligro la misión.

programme.title: Petronix
programme.desc: Cuando Jia intenta demostrar que Paul-E tiene los mejores movimientos para esta misión, descubre que el movimiento más fuerte es trabajar en equipo.

programme.title: Petronix
programme.desc: Cuando la princesa captura un equipo de perros esquimales, los Petronix Defenders tendrán que enseñar a sus mascotas a seguir el plan de rescate en lugar de competir entre sí.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Las Ardillas se divierten tocando una canción que han hecho, pero les gustaría poder verse actuando. Duggee tiene una gran sugerencia y aprenden a ser creativos y a grabarse con una cámara para hacer un vídeo musical.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee y las ardillas salen juntos a correr para entrar en calor. Las ardillas tienen sueño, pero les dicen que un poco de ejercicio las despertará. Por el camino, aprenden cómo les gusta hacer ejercicio a los demás y los beneficios que se obtienen.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Duggee es interrumpido leyendo el periódico cuando las Ardillas están causando un desastre a su alrededor. Se toma un momento para explicar que las Ardillas necesitan pensar más detenidamente en lo que están haciendo.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Las ardillas disfrutan observando a los pájaros con Duggee, pero quieren saber qué más hacen los pájaros, aparte de volar. Él les explica que pueden aprender más sobre la naturaleza si siguen cinco sencillos pasos.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Las ardillas hambrientas acuden a Duggee cuando no saben qué comer y, afortunadamente, él tiene su libro de cocina La cocina de la casa club: platos deliciosos para ardillas hambrientas. Las ardillas aprenden los pasos para completar una receta.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Cuando las Ardillas le dicen a Duggee que no les queda nada con lo que jugar y que ya le ayudaron a organizar su colección de tenedores la semana pasada, éste les anima a usar su imaginación.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: Norrie se siente como si siempre hubiera estado en el club, pero hoy recuerda cómo fue su primer día. Ella fue la primera en llegar al club y al principio se sentía sola. Pero al conocer a Enid, juntas exploraron la casa de juegos.

programme.title: Aprendemos en Clan
programme.desc: Los Clanners quieren conocer el origen de las patatas fritas. Orilo y Arlequina consiguen crear electricidad a través de una patata y Welelo explica el origen de las patatas fritas. Nerea habla de Parmentier y la importancia de descubrir.

programme.title: La casa de muñecas de Gabby
programme.desc: Super-Gabby y Super-Pandy encogen para enfrentarse a Yogato el Villano. ¿Podrán resolver sus divertidos rompecabezas? ¡Que empiecen las maravillosas misiones!

programme.title: La casa de muñecas de Gabby
programme.desc: ¡Con las manos, puré preparamos! Gabby y sus amigos están listos para un día de spa, pero el brillo de Siregata empieza a desaparecer. ¿Podrán ayudarla a recuperarlo?

programme.title: La casa de muñecas de Gabby
programme.desc: Gabby y Pandy se lo pasan bomba en un día de temática pirata lleno de aventuras, música, mapas y viajes mágicos. Muffin hace un tutorial para preparar dulces deliciosos.

programme.title: La casa de muñecas de Gabby
programme.desc: Al buzón llega una entrega especial, una caja decorada con hojas y flores. En su interior hay una macetita, un saquito de tierra, una pequeña regadera y una semilla chiquitita. Gabby planta la semilla.

programme.title: Croco doc

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: It's Erin Burnett's turn to step out front and try to maintain a viable viewer presence for CNN in the weekday news arena. But the former CNBC anchor won't worry about ratings for her hourlong general news program, comparing that burden to "death." Instead, she'll concern herself with translating world events into relevant information for viewers, paying close attention to such topics as the Middle East and women's issues. "I want people to say that our show is smart. I want our show to be authentic", Burnett says in a promo. "I want our show to have courage". Left unsaid, of course, is that she wants her show to have a big audience, too.

programme.desc: Las últimas noticias, momentos destacados e información de todos los rincones del mundo del deporte se presenta cada día en "SportsCenter", el primer programa de ESPN cuando la red se estrenó en septiembre de 1979. La serie se transmite en tres ediciones nocturnas, luego se re-transmite la última edición cuatro veces cada mañana de lunes a viernes antes de despejar el escenario para un bloque de seis horas de "SportsCenter" en vivo, que pone más énfasis en la interactividad de los fanáticos, noticias, análisis, comentarios y la cobertura de las conferencias de prensa.

programme.title: Mass And Celebration of Divine Mercy From Stockbridge, Ma
programme.desc: On this Divine Mercy Sunday, celebrate the beauty of God's infinite love for all of mankind with this Solemn Mass, live from the National Shrine of the Divine Mercy in Stockbridge, Massachusetts.

programme.title: Into the Breach

programme.title: Reminders of God's Love: The Sacred Heart & the Divine Mercy

programme.title: Sunday Mass

programme.title: The Litany of the Sacred Heart of Jesus

programme.title: Savoring Our Faith
programme.desc: Travel the world with Fr. Leo as he visits pilgrimage sites and explores our rich Catholic faith. At each stop, he samples tasty local dishes and provides nourishing spiritual advice.

programme.title: Tad the Lost Explorer and the Emerald Tablet
programme.desc: An explorer races across the far corners of the planet to stop the curse of the Emerald Tablet before things get really out of hand.

programme.title: Playing With Fire
programme.desc: When a straight-laced fire superintendent and his elite team of firefighters come to the rescue of three siblings, they quickly realize that no amount of training could prepare them for their most challenging job yet - babysitting.

programme.title: Spies in Disguise
programme.desc: A charming super spy and his geeky scientist companion are almost exact opposites. But what the scientist lacks in social skills he makes up for in invention, creating awesome gadgets for the spy to use on his epic missions.

programme.title: Mysterious Island
programme.desc: Two soldiers whose bid to escape from the American Civil War takes them involuntarily to a South Seas island. Here, accompanied by three other renegades, they encounter two beautiful English ladies who've been shipwrecked and a host of less-than-beautiful monsters.

programme.title: Central Intelligence
programme.desc: Bullied as a teen for being overweight, Bob Stone shows up to his high school reunion looking fit and muscular. While there, he finds Calvin Joyner, a fast-talking accountant who misses his glory days as a popular athlete. Stone is now a lethal CIA agent who needs Calvin's number skills to help him save the compromised US spy satellite system. Together, the former classmates encounter shootouts, espionage and double-crosses while trying to prevent worldwide chaos.

programme.title: Ghost Rider
programme.desc: Comic-book adventure about a stunt motorcyclist tricked into making a pact with Mephistopheles. The rider can only escape doing the demon's bidding if he agrees to battle the dark lord's son. To this end, he assumes the identity of the supernatural Ghost Rider, a terrifying night-time vigilante with a flaming skull.

programme.title: The Unbearable Weight of Massive Talent
programme.desc: Facing financial ruin, actor Nick Cage accepts $1 million to attend a wealthy fan's birthday party. Taking on the role of a lifetime, he soon finds himself channeling his most iconic and beloved characters to save himself and his loved ones.

programme.title: Smile
programme.desc: After witnessing a traumatic incident, Dr. Cotter starts experiencing frightening occurrences that she can't explain. As an overwhelming terror begins taking over her life, she must confront her troubling past to escape her horrifying new reality.

programme.title: The Kid Who Would Be King
programme.desc: Old-school magic meets the modern world when young Alex stumbles upon the mythical sword Excalibur. He soon unites his friends and enemies into a band of knights who join forces with the legendary wizard Merlin. Together, they must save mankind from the wicked enchantress Morgana and her army of supernatural warriors.

programme.title: Anne of the Thousand Days
programme.desc: Henry VIII of England discards one wife, Katharine of Aragon, who has failed to produce a male heir, in favour of the young and beautiful Anne Boleyn.

programme.title: Deep Impact
programme.desc: Apocalyptic thriller in which life on Earth is threatened by a rogue comet. When a reporter in pursuit of a Washington sex scandal is arrested by the FBI, she discovers that the story is an inconsequential part of a huge cover-up. She soon finds herself in possession of the biggest story in the history of humankind, the planet will be destroyed in one year, unless a risky outer-space mission can deflect the comet.

programme.title: Battleship Interview Special
programme.desc: Director Peter Berg and stars Rihanna, Brooklyn Decker and Taylor Kitsch talk about making the seaborne sci-fi blockbuster `Battleship'.

programme.title: Sister Act 2: Back in the Habit
programme.desc: Sequel in which a nightclub singer is asked to get back into her habit when her old friends at St Catherine's Convent find difficulty in controlling a school filled with juvenile delinquents. Convincing everyone that she is a nun is going to be a challenge in itself, especially with a group of incompetent monks trying to hinder their efforts.

programme.title: The Great Wall
programme.desc: Two European knights of fortune have travelled to China in their search for a magical black powder that can wreak havoc. When they suddenly come under attack by some monstrous figures, they seek refuge.

programme.title: Four Lions
programme.desc: In a British city, four men have a secret plan. Omar is disillusioned about the treatment of Muslims around the world and wants to strike at the heart of the enemy. Waj will die for the cause, but opposed to Omar, and almost everyone else on earth, is white convert Barry. While Omar takes Waj to training camp, Barry recruits Hassan - a student so keen to prove he's for real, he'll bomb a mosque to kick off the End Times.

programme.title: Not Okay
programme.desc: A misguided young woman who is desperate for friends and fame fakes a trip to Paris to update her social media presence. A terrifying incident takes place in the real world, which becomes a part of the imaginary trip and offers all she wants.

programme.title: The Lost World
programme.desc: Thrilling story about a zoology professor who leads an expedition to a high plateau in the Amazon jungle where prehistoric life has survived. The party does indeed find dinosaurs, giant spiders and cannibals but when they lose their equipment they are soon running for their lives. Based on the novel by Sir Arthur Conan Doyle.

programme.title: The Simpsons Movie
programme.desc: The combination of Homer, his new pet pig, and a leaky silo full of excrement triggers a disaster that threatens not just Springfield but the entire world. An angry mob descends on the Simpson home, splitting the family. With Earth's fate in the balance, Homer sets out on a quest for redemption in order to save the world and earn Marge's forgiveness.

programme.title: Secret Headquarters
programme.desc: A kid discovers the secret headquarters of a powerful superhero hidden beneath his home and must defend it with his group of friends when villains attack.

programme.title: The Poseidon Adventure
programme.desc: A priest leads a ragtag group of survivors on a quest to escape the capsized ocean liner Poseidon. On their way to the safety of the propeller shaft, which has become their only route to survival, they must overcome fire, steam and lots of water.

programme.title: Dad's Army
programme.desc: Near the end of World War II, the Walmington-on-Sea Home Guard platoon deals with a female journalist and a German spy.

programme.title: Peppermint
programme.desc: Riley awakens from a coma, after surviving an attack that killed both her husband and her daughter. When justice fails to prevail, Riley becomes an urban guerilla to serve up her own brand of punishment.

programme.title: The Dive
programme.desc: A deep-sea diving trip turns into a fight for survival for two sisters when a catastrophic landslide sends rocks tumbling into the ocean, trapping one of them below the surface.

programme.title: Hustlers
programme.desc: Ramona shows Destiny how to finagle her way around the Wall street clientele who frequent their strip club. But when the 2008 economic collapse cuts into their profits, the gals and two other dancers devise a daring scheme to take their lives back.
