programme.title: Le tour du monde en 80 Jours
programme.desc: La montgolfière atterrit à San Francisco après une attaque. Fix et Bully tombent en mer. Fogg est provoqué en duel, mais il brise l'arme de son opposant d'un coup de canne. Départ en train transcontinental vers New York.

programme.title: Tico et ses amis
programme.desc: La baleine lumineuse a été capturée par l'équipe de Beineix. Elle est transportée en hélicoptère, ce qui peut s'avérer fatal pour le mammifère, très sensible aux rayons ultra-violets.

programme.title: Tico et ses amis
programme.desc: Le Peperochino a pris feu. Lorsque le professeur Leconte découvre que Beineix souhaite construire une arme biochimique, il décide de relâcher la baleine avec l'aide de Scott. Les amis recherchent les photos de la baleine pour prouver qu'elle existe.

programme.title: Le College Fou, Fou, Fou
programme.desc: Laura et son amie trouvent un portefeuille. Avec l'argent, Laura invite les joyeux loufoques dans un bar pour prendre un verre. Plus tard, Ray et ses copains trouvent un sac rempli d'argent.

programme.title: Le College Fou, Fou, Fou
programme.desc: Jackie est amoureuse de Monsieur Gildas. Elle tente de lui avouer son amour mais croit l'avoir déçu. Monsieur Gildas décide d'apprendre aux élèves comment éteindre un feu.

programme.title: Les Minipouss
programme.desc: Marie, une jeune fille dont le carnet de note est médiocre, décide de s'enfuir de chez elle redoutant que son père ne l'envoie en pension. Lucie arrive à se cacher dans la poche de Marie. Les minipouss, aidés d'Eric, partent à leur recherche.

programme.title: Il était une fois ... l'espace
programme.desc: Pierrot et Psi reviennent sur terre après leur dangereuse mission et doivent y prendre quelques jours de repos. Ils en profitent pour apprendre à connaître un peu mieux leur planète d'origine et Maestro les accompagne.

programme.title: Il était une fois ... l'espace
programme.desc: A l'occasion de la prochaine traversée spatiale du Cosmopolitain, Petit Gros va rejoindre Oméga. Pierrot profitera des vacances qui lui restent pour visiter, en compagnie de Maestro, les villes et installations sous-marines que lui a vantées le vieux Maître.

programme.title: Wakfu
programme.desc: La vie du jeune Yugo change à jamais lorsqu'il découvre qu'il est capable de créer des portails de téléportation.

programme.title: Wakfu
programme.desc: Yugo, Percedal et Ruel se rendent dans la Forêt interdite, à la recherche d'un moyen de libérer les habitants du village frappés par un mal étrange.

programme.title: Dofus : aux trésors de Kérubim
programme.desc: Le Baron a battu Kerubim les doigts dans la truffe et notre aventurier n'a plus rien, il ne lui reste que son slip pour pleurer. Errant dans les rues d'Ecaflip City comme un vulgaire Chacha de gouttière, Kerubim n'est plus que l'ombre de lui-même.

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Un monstre marin attaque les bateaux naviguant sur la Tamise avant de les dévorer. Lorsqu'un passager est porté disparu sans que l'on puisse retrouver son corps, Holmes est appelé à la rescousse !

programme.title: Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: Trois étudiants en arts venus de France en vacances à Londres sont portés disparus. Holmes part à la recherche tandis que l'inspecteur Lestrade tente de découvrir pourquoi quelqu'un souhaiterait dérober des reproductions d'oeuvres d'art.

programme.title: Le College Fou, Fou, Fou
programme.desc: En faisant des fouilles dans la cour de l'école, nos amis découvrent un crâne de dinosaure. Lors d'une fête, Ray décide de remplacer un prêtre qui est malade.

programme.title: Le College Fou, Fou, Fou
programme.desc: Jim arrive à l'école avec un parapluie de fille. Ses amis lui demandent des explications. En fait, depuis quelque temps, Jim voit une jeune fille à l'hôpital. Monsieur Gildas n'a plus d'argent et plus rien à manger jusqu'à la prochaine paie.

programme.title: Les Minipouss
programme.desc: Eric propose à ses parents de faire du baby-sitting pendant que ces derniers se rendent à une conférence avec des amis. Mais Eric se décharge très vite de cette tâche en confiant la garde du nourrisson aux Minipouss pour aller jouer au Football.

programme.title: Montana
programme.desc: Alfred et Montana sont engagés dans une campagne de fouilles près de Cerveteri. La découverte d'un précieux pot en bucchero les incite à retourner à Boston pour le présenter aux financiers.

programme.title: Montana
programme.desc: Alfred est engagé dans une fouille archéologique dans la forêt d'Amérique centrale lorsqu'il reçoit un message de Gerrit : il doit trouver la ville monumentale des Olmèques, où est enterrée une mosaïque dédiée au dieu Jaguar.

programme.title: Il était une fois... la Vie
programme.desc: Il y a 3,5 milliards d'années, apparaissait la première forme de vie : la cellule, capable de s'autorépliquer grâce à l'ADN. Dans le corps humain, une cellule est à la base de tout. C'est une véritable usine, avec ses fabriques de production, de gestion d'énergie, ses réserves, son centre de décision.

programme.title: Il était une fois... la Vie
programme.desc: La rencontre entre un spermatozoïde et un ovule crée la fécondation. Pendant neuf mois, des cellules vont construire le corps du futur bébé.

programme.title: Dofus : aux trésors de Kérubim
programme.desc: Simone se prépare pour un rendez-vous galant. Il ne lui manque plus qu'un bijou pour être parfaite. Joris trouve un diamant dans les affaires de Kerubim. Mais un énorme Craqueleur en surgit et menace de détruire toute la boutique !

programme.title: All Out!
programme.desc: Kenji Gion, lycéen audacieux et fonceur, choisit de rejoindre le club de rugby de son école malgré sa petite taille. Sa rencontre avec les autres membres du club va l'amener à se dépasser pour faire de son club la meilleure équipe.

programme.title: Radiant
programme.desc: Mordred explique pourquoi il a trahi Ocoho. De plus, ce dernier n'a pas d'autre choix que d'affronter la reine Boadicée.

programme.title: Pretty Guardian Sailor Moon Stars
programme.desc: Sailor Moon et les Guerrières de la Lune s'apprêtent à affronter leur plus grand défi : le lycée ! Mais alors que les filles franchissent cette nouvelle étape de leur vie, une force mystérieuse libère la maléfique Reine Nehelennia !

programme.title: Dragon Quest : L'aventure de Dai
programme.desc: Popp rassemble tout son courage et se dresse face à Crocodine, mais se fait piétiner sans pitié. À bout de forces, il lance pourtant un sort décisif pour sauver Fly (Daï) et provoquer un retournement miraculeux.

programme.title: Dragon Quest : L'aventure de Dai
programme.desc: Grâce au geste désespéré de Popp, Fly (Daï), en colère face à la lâcheté de l'ennemi, voit une marque briller sur son front. Déterminé à ne pas perdre, Crocodine se prépare à lancer sa redoutable technique : la Désolation du roi des carnassiers.

programme.title: Nicky Larson
programme.desc: Kathleen Heywood est une jeune femme aux qualités athlétiques remarquables. Elle travaille aux côtés de Dandy Jack, et ils ont comme intérêt commun d'éliminer Mammouth par vengeance. Mammouth appelle Nicky afin qu'il tienne compagnie à Kathleen.

programme.title: Nicky Larson
programme.desc: Malgré ses graves blessures, Mammouth se lance tout de même à la poursuite de Dandy Jack pour terminer le travail qu'il a laissé inachevé huit années auparavant. De son côté, Kathleen ne peut évacuer la haine qu'elle éprouve.

programme.title: Nicky Larson
programme.desc: L'avion dans lequel voyage Misa Williams, la fille d'un leader d'un mouvement révolutionnaire de la république de Pamela, se fait détourner par des pirates de l'air, et toutes les femmes à son bord sont retenues prisonnières.

programme.title: Ranma 1/2
programme.desc: Roland doit passer un examen d'entrée avant d'intégrer le dojo de la famille Galant. Pour le préparer, il a le droit demeurer chez eux. Il commence donc à s'entraîner, excité et ravi de pouvoir passer autant de temps aux côtés d'Adeline.

programme.title: Ranma 1/2
programme.desc: Alors qu'il tente de dérober des sous-vêtements dans une école d'infirmière, maître Ernestin est surpris par une très belle professeure. Il tombe immédiatement fou amoureux d'elle et promet de se ranger.

programme.title: Ranma 1/2
programme.desc: Un diseur de bonne aventure annonce à Julian qu'il vivra heureux avec une des filles Galant. À l'annonce de la prédiction, Julian décide d'ouvrir son cœur à la jeune fille. Mais les choses se passeront-elles telles qu'on lui a prédit ?

programme.title: Ranma 1/2
programme.desc: Pour le remercier de sa gentillesse, un vieil homme fait de Roland l'homme le plus fort du monde. Pour cela, il lui dessine un drôle de gribouillage sur le ventre, que Roland trouve ridicule.

programme.title: Ranma 1/2
programme.desc: Adeline s'inquiète de voir Ranma avec le même signe que celui dessiné sur le ventre de Roland. Elle sait que quelque chose cloche mais aucun des deux garçons ne veut se confier à elle !

programme.title: Valérian et Laureline
programme.desc: Combattant émérite dans la réalité comme dans le virtuel, Valérian remporte le premier prix d'un jeu de combat de robots holographiques. Il gagne un magnifique séjour pour deux personnes, tous frais payés dans un hôtel somptueux sur la merveilleuse planète Farniza !

programme.title: Valérian et Laureline
programme.desc: Valérian et Laureline sont de retour sur Point Central. A peine descendue du vaisseau, Laureline ne résiste pas devant les étalages de bijoux vivants.

programme.title: Les enfants du Mondial
programme.desc: Brian se remémore la finale surprise de la Coupe du monde 1974 : Allemagne - Hollande.

programme.title: Les enfants du Mondial
programme.desc: Argentine, 1978. Brian est à Buenos Aires pour voir le match Italie - Argentine. Kim l'accompagne pour rencontrer Jack Felton. Ils tombent amoureux l'un de l'autre, mais Jack doit rentrer à Londres pour le travail et Kim décide de le suivre.

programme.title: Les enfants du Mondial
programme.desc: Barcelone, 1982. Lors de la Coupe du monde en Espagne, contre toute attente, l'Italie bat les grands favoris brésiliens grâce aux 3 buts de Paolo Rossi. Brian a en sa possession un autographe de l'équipe bleue qui va en faire rêver plus d'un.

programme.title: Les enfants du Mondial
programme.desc: 1978, Argentine. Lors d'une soirée où l'équipe nationale se présente aux média, Brian apprend que sa nièce va se marier. Il se rend à Londres pour la cérémonie puis repart en Argentine pour le match Argentine-Hollande.

programme.title: The Leadoff Spot
programme.desc: Co-hosted by a combination of veteran baseball analysts - Steve Phillips, Xavier Scruggs and Eduardo Pérez - the program will deliver expert commentary, plus interviews with baseball newsmakers and club personnel.

programme.title: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown."

programme.title: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.title: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown."

programme.title: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. programme.desc: Si solo se ha sentado en la parte trasera de una gran limusina y si no sabe lo que son este tipo de limusinas, probablemente forme parte de la direccion. Cuando se trata de experiencia de conduccion y rendimiento, es logico que el asiento del conductor sea menos atractivo. Pero, de todos modos, eso solo ocurre con los coches estatales más experimentados. El Audi RS y el Mercedes Clase S podrían incluso dejar sin trabajo a algunos choferes.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Con la creacion de su i8, el fabricante de automoviles muniques BMW da un gran paso hacia el futuro. Al fin y al cabo, este coche de aspecto futurista es el primer deportivo alemán que utiliza tecnología híbrida. Supercars comprueba el BMW i8 en las calles de Los Ángeles. Pero BMW no solo ha trabajado en el i8. Tambien presentan el nuevo coupe deportivo 435i y el SUV deportivo X550d M.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: No siempre es la potencia pura de un coche lo que hace que la conduccion en las curvas sea emocionante. El Subaru BRZ, con su motor boxer bajo y su manejo bien equilibrado, da a su conductor una muy buena sensacion para la carretera. El BMW 235i RS tiene un gran rendimiento en la rueda trasera y el Porsche Cayman GTS, con su motor central, pone una sonrisa en la cara en cuanto se pisa el acelerador.

programme.title: Chevrolet Camaro 50th
programme.desc: 50 años del Chevrolet Camaro. La marca americana lo celebra con un modelo especial de 453 CV. Probamos el coupe en las estribaciones de los Alpes.

programme.title: Ingeniería del Futuro
programme.desc: Las compañías navieras y los ingenieros crean nuevas máquinas para hacer que su industria sea más ecologica utilizando un recurso que ha movido al hombre a traves de los oceanos durante miles de años, el viento.

programme.title: Ingeniería del Futuro
programme.desc: El sol es la mayor fuente de energía en el sistema solar. Los innovadores buscan nuevas formas de capturar más energía del sol.

programme.title: Made In...
programme.desc: Jaguar y Land Rover están experimentando una transformacion bajo el paraguas del grupo indio Tata. Jaguar se rejuvenece y Land Rover se amplía con nuevos modelos. Mostramos la cuerda floja entre tradicion e innovacion.

programme.title: Made In...
programme.desc: Dresde es el buque insignia del Grupo Volkswagen en materia de electromovilidad. En el corazon de la metropolis del Elba se encuentra la Glaserne Manufaktur, una extraordinaria planta de produccion para el e-Golf y el laboratorio del futuro de VW.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: En 2018, el Audi R8 Quattro Performance recibio una actualizacion. La nueva version compartía algunas de sus características aerodinámicas con el Lamborghini Huracan. Además, el Porsche Macan S obtuvo un motor más potente.

programme.title: Porsche 911 Targa
programme.desc: Un descapotable con mucha potencia: el Porsche 911 Targa, el clásico de culto por excelencia.

programme.title: Porsche 911 Carrera S
programme.desc: Conducir un Porsche Carrera S en una pista de hielo gigante es el sueño de todo aficionado a los coches deportivos. Las ruedas traseras empiezan a girar y las comisuras de los labios parecen quedarse detrás de las orejas.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Mustang celebra su 50 aniversario en la pista de carreras de Las Vegas y Marco decide participar de este evento especial. Además, será testigo de como se fabrican Shelby Cobras en exclusiva para clientes de todo el mundo. Despues de esta experiencia con Mustang, Marco continúa su viaje por los Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: Los petroleros de California solo pueden pensar en los caballos de fuerza y en el tamaño del motor. El deportivo híbrido BMW i8 combina estos valores clásicos con el pensamiento ecologico y marca nuevas tendencias medioambientales. Pero, ¿como responden los petrolheads conservadores a un coche tan futurista y limpio? En el Road Trip por Los Ángeles algunos adictos al octanaje que suelen conducir un Porsche 911, un Chevy Corvette o motos tuneadas prueban el BMW i8.

programme.title: Motorstories
programme.desc: La alemana Kati es una entusiasta de los coches americanos. Junto a su amigo Patrick, hizo realidad sus sueños comprando un Chevy Chevelle de 1972. Este extraño coche fue descubierto por Frank Slopianka, cuya compañía "Special Cars Berlin

programme.title: Chrysler C-300
programme.desc: El Chrysler 300 C fue el vehículo de produccion más potente de America. Se gano el apodo de "The Bankers Hot Rod".

programme.title: Toyota Land Cruiser
programme.desc: El Toyota Land Cruiser tiene más exito que los vehículos todoterreno de Mercedes, Land Rover y compañía. La facilidad de suministro de piezas del Land Cruiser marca la diferencia. Este tanque realmente lleva todo y a todos de A a B.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: El Mercedes Silver Arrows es uno de los coches de carreras clásicos por excelencia. Acompañamos al piloto de carreras Jochen Mass por la carretera alpina de Grossglockner. Y además: el Porsche 550 RS Spyder supuso la base del exito de la marca alemana en todo el mundo; en 1980, Audi causo sensacion en el mundo del automovil cuando presento el Quattro con su traccion a las cuatro ruedas.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: El Facel Vega Facellia podrá ser un coche precioso pero las ambiciones de su fabricante se vieron frenadas por numerosas dificultades tecnicas. Y además: el exito del legendario Citroën 2CV comenzo con humildad; en la decada de 1970, el Renault Alpine A110 cosecho grandes exitos en los circuitos de rally; un reparador alemán devolvio a la carretera un clásico Bugatti Tipo 57.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: El VW Type 166 Schwimmwagen es único y a la vez el autentico todoterreno entre todos los de su clase. Y además: en los años 80, el Peugeot 205 Turbo 16 fue toda una sensacion en el Campeonato Mundial de Rallyes; el Jeep Willys: el todoterreno de tierra entusiasmo a los fans del off-road de todo el mundo.

programme.title: Lancia Beta Montecarlo
programme.desc: Un pequeño biplaza italiano con motor central. El Lancia Beta Monte Carlo ofrece el placer de conducir coches clásicos a un precio de entrada bajo.

programme.title: BMW M3 E30
programme.desc: En 1986 nacio una leyenda: el BMW M3, uno de los coches de carreras más exitosos de la historia. Se sentía en casa tanto en el deporte del motor como en la carretera. De 1987 a 1992, el M3 Turismo gano el campeonato del DTM en dos ocasiones.

programme.title: Jochen Mass en el Mercedes flecha de plata W125
programme.desc: El GroSSglockner. Al pie de la carretera de los Alpes: coches de epoca. Se reúnen para el Gran Premio de GroSSglockner: 92 curvas y hasta un 11% de pendiente. El campo de salida consta de 75 vehículos, al igual que en la primera carrera de 1935.

programme.title: New Zealand Jetsprint Championship
programme.desc: En el Grupo A, Matt Hareb se enfrenta al vigente campeon, Ollie Silverton, mientras que Rasmussen tambien entra en liza. Las decisiones reñidas y el rendimiento constante de los pilotos garantizan un emocionante inicio de temporada.

programme.title: New Zealand Jetsprint Championship
programme.desc: En la primera etapa en Featherston, las Superboats acapararon toda la atencion cuando Sam Newdick se enfrento a Reuben Hoeksema en una final espectacular. Este intenso duelo estuvo caracterizado por carreras rápidas y emocionantes.

programme.title: Icelandic Formula Offroad
programme.desc: En Hella comienza la temporada de la Icelandic Formula Off-Road. Potentes máquinas se enfrentan a terrenos extremos y ofrecen accion espectacular, el rugido de los motores y los primeros duelos emocionantes de un nuevo y apasionante campeonato.

programme.title: Icelandic Formula Offroad
programme.desc: La Icelandic Formula Off-Road continúa con las etapas cuatro a seis. Los pilotos se enfrentarán a cruces de ríos, tramos pantanosos y la contrarreloj en su lucha por los primeros puntos.

programme.title: Porsche Panamera Sport Turismo
programme.desc: We take out the Porsche Panamera Sport Turismo for a couple of rounds

programme.title: Ponga su carro en la TV
programme.desc: Se invita a los maníacos de los coches a traer sus vehículos tuneados a "The Walk

programme.title: Ponga su carro en la TV
programme.desc: Pon tu coche en la tele invita a los propietarios de coches a que los califique Saif Hattawi. La persona con más puntos ganará un regalo especial del Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. Incluye: un BMW X5 y un Mercedes SLK 230.

programme.title: Ponga su carro en la TV
programme.desc: La gente de Oriente Medio está loca por sus coches. En Put Your Car on TV, pueden presentar sus vehículos tuneados y calificados. Entre los competidores de hoy se encuentran un Nova SS, un Honda Acord especial y un coche lleno de cristales.

programme.title: BMW M6 Gran Coupe
programme.desc: El M6 Gran Coupe es la última joya de las plantas M de BMW. Es ancho y bajo y cuenta con las tomas de aire extragrandes típicas de esta serie. Los bávaros sacan a relucir su martillo V8 y demuestran lo que significa tener la sensacion de volar.

programme.title: Porsche 911 GT3 RS
programme.desc: Los grandes alerones traseros sugieren que hay mucha potencia escondida bajo el capo que debe ser controlada, ya que estos alerones proporcionan la carga aerodinámica necesaria. El Porsche GT3 RS tiene un aleron trasero muy especial.

programme.title: Carreras clásicas
programme.desc: La subida a la colina de Pikes Peak de 1987. Un tipo de carrera bastante diferente en las montañas de Colorado, EE.UU.. Es única, fascinante y llena de aventura.

programme.title: Carreras clásicas
programme.desc: Desde 1934, el Gran Premio ha sido el campeonato mundial más emocionante y fascinante del mundo. Con sus vehículos de última generacion, con los caballos de potencia de las marcas más grandes, nunca deja de impresionar a sus espectadores.

programme.title: Carreras clásicas
programme.desc: El campeonato internacional de fabricantes fue una serie de rallyes que se desarrollo entre 1970 y 72. Fabricantes de coches como Porsche, Renault y Ford participaron, con Ford teniendo un año excepcionalmente exitoso en 1972.

programme.title: Carreras clásicas
programme.desc: El campeonato alemán de coches de turismo de 1992: definitivamente una de las series de carreras más importantes del deporte del motor alemán. Duro, despiadado y bien conocido por las duras batallas de sus despiadados competidores.

programme.title: Carreras clásicas
programme.desc: Temperaturas tropicales, polvo interminable y curvas - algunas de las muchas dificultades para el hombre y la máquina durante el gran premio de 1964 en Argentina. Esta carrera fue la responsable de llevar a la marca Mercedes a la cima.

programme.title: Bandslam
programme.desc: A gifted singer/songwriter, Charlotte hires Will Burton, a new guy in town, to manage her fledgling rock band. She wants one thing from him: to help her win a contest against her ex-boyfriend in an upcoming battle of the bands. Charlotte's band comes together and seems to have a real shot at victory, while Will and dynamic guitarist Sa5m begin to make some beautiful music of their own.

programme.title: The von Trapp Family: A Life of Music
programme.desc: Agathe, the eldest daughter of a famous musical family, overcomes obstacles to pursue a career in music in the United States.

programme.title: Prince of Central Park
programme.desc: JJ chooses the streets of New York over his foster mother and must live by a new set of rules or risk becoming an NYPD statistic. Only one couple has a chance to save JJ, but a dark secret may stop them.

programme.title: The Legend of Catclaws Mountain
programme.desc: Mindy adopts Angel, a high-spirited pony that according to legend will lead its owner to gold hidden in the nearby mountains. When Angel is kidnapped by a mad treasure hunter, Mindy and her school friends head into the hills to rescue the pony and hunt for the lost gold.

programme.desc: The wooden hero is a skilled circus acrobat who longs to become human when he falls for the ringmaster's daughter.

programme.title: Turtle Tale
programme.desc: Rafi, Hank and Goliath, a trio of talking turtles, are living the good life at a Florida animal park. But when vandals kidnap Hank, it's up to Rafi and Goliath to find their missing friend.

programme.title: The Magic Penguin
programme.desc: When a beloved talking penguin named Roi is kidnapped by a couple of criminals, his home country is thrown into a tailspin. The most trusted knight in the land and his young son must join forces to rescue their fine feathered friend.

programme.title: Little Gobie
programme.desc: While snowboarding, Little Gobie and his pet dragon BeBe get into a accident. Bebe gets injured, Little Gobie looks for help from Santa Claus.

programme.desc: The grandson (Drake Bell) of professor Julius Kelp (Jerry Lewis) finds an elixir that releases an obnoxious alter ego.

programme.title: H Is for Happiness
programme.desc: An optimistic 12-year-old girl hatches scheme after scheme to make her mother, father and uncle happy again.

programme.title: Starting Out in the Evening
programme.desc: A complex relationship develops between Leonard (Frank Langella), an academic novelist of advancing years, and Heather (Lauren Ambrose), a determined, fresh-faced graduate student doing her master's thesis on Leonard's career. Leonard keeps everyone at an emotional distance, including his devoted daughter, Ariel (Lili Taylor), and her unsettled boyfriend, Casey (Adrian Lester). Heather's attention, although motivated by selfish interests, forces Leonard to reexamine his life.

programme.title: Before I Fall
programme.desc: Samantha Kingston (Zoey Deutch) seems to have it all: popularity, a loving boyfriend (Kian Lawley) and a seemingly perfect future. Everything changes in the blink of an eye when she dies in a car crash but then magically wakes up to find herself reliving the same day over and over again. As Samantha tries to untangle the mystery of a life derailed, she must also unravel the secrets of the people closest to her and discover how the power of a single day can make a difference.

programme.title: Bart Got a Room
programme.desc: Everyone is searching for love in director Brian Hecker's semi-autobiographical story. Danny Stein (Steven J. Kaplan), a high school senior at the bottom of the social food chain, needs a prom date. As a cause of anxiety for Danny, Bart Beeber (Chad Jamian Williams), the nerdiest guy in school, has already found a date -- and booked a hotel room. At the same time, Danny's divorced parents (William H. Macy, Cheryl Hines) are both looking for relationships again.

The battle to topple Stonebanks becomes a clash of old-school methods vs. high-tech expertise.

His latest job leads to a double-cross, leaving him stuck in a high-tech facility with the worst that society has to offer. Luckily for Ray, he meets Emil Rottmayer (Arnold Schwarzenegger), an inmate who secretly helps him hatch a plot to win his freedom. Mike sees potential in a 19-year-old he dubs the Kid (Alex Pettyfer), takes the teen under his wing and instructs him in the tricks of the trade. However, Mike learns there's a downside to the stripper lifestyle when it threatens his romance with the Kid's sister.

But when things go awry, Mallory knows she'll die unless she can turn the tables on her adversary.

programme.title: Traficantes
programme.desc: Las operaciones aéreas y marítimas en Santo Tomás detienen a un presunto contrabandista y persiguen una embarcación que huye hacia aguas de las Islas Vírgenes Británicas. La Oficina de Aduanas y Protección Fronteriza de EE. UU. detiene a una madre y a su hija que contrabandeaban grandes cantidades de marihuana a través del Aeropuerto Internacional de Miami hacia el Caribe. En El Paso, las alertas del K9 llevan a los agentes a descubrir drogas y armas en varios vehículos.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Sabores extremos

programme.title: Salvajemente famosos

programme.title: Mayday: Catástrofes aéreas

programme.title: Secreto en los océanos

programme.title: Alerta aeropuerto: Sao Paulo

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Al final de la década de los ochentas, en el negocio ilícito más lucrativo de la época, "el oro blanco", las rutas de las Bahamas y Florida, ya no son tan viables para el transporte de la cocaína; la persecución de los miembros de los carteles colombianos y su guerra entre ellos mismos se intensifica, generando que estos bandidos sean extraditados, encarcelados en su país o asesinados. Algunos son condenados al encierro voluntario, escondidos en algún rincón para evitar su captura, por cuenta de las fuerzas armadas o de sus enemigos. El negocio cambia y es cuando aparece Amado Carrillo Fuentes "El Señor de los Cielos" que en forma muy discreta se dedica al transporte del producto que proveen los narcotraficantes colombianos restantes, convirtiéndose en el narcotraficante más poderoso de los cuatro carteles que operan en México: el de Juárez, el del Golfo, el de Sinaloa y el de Tijuana. Su historia se devela en este drama cargado de acción y giros inusitados.

programme.title: 7 à la maison

programme.title: The Fifth Element
programme.desc: A futuristic cab driver's latest passenger, a woman created from an alien cell, may be mankind's last hope of saving Earth from impending doom.

programme.title: A Hazard of Hearts
programme.desc: An 1810 nobleman wins a girl in a wager and sends her to his mother's dark mansion.

programme.title: Tea With Mussolini
programme.desc: A young Italian boy is taken in by an Englishwoman and her group of eccentric friends in the middle of World War II.

programme.title: Dead Again
programme.desc: A private investigator tries to unravel the past of a woman suffering from amnesia, who is haunted by nightmares involving a murder that took place in the 1940s.

programme.title: John Wick: Chapter 2
programme.desc: Legendary hit man John Wick comes out of retirement when a former associate plots to take control of an international assassins' guild. Bound by a blood oath to help him, Wick travels to Rome to square off against the world's deadliest killers.

programme.title: Mamacruz
programme.desc: A religious grandmother learns how to use the internet. When she accidentally comes across pornography, she is faced with a dilemma.

programme.title: The Orator
programme.desc: Saili, a taro farmer with dwarfism, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status, despite the current village chief's scepticism. Saili must prove his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community, and must speak up to defend the ones he loves.

programme.title: A Hazard of Hearts
programme.desc: An 1810 nobleman wins a girl in a wager and sends her to his mother's dark mansion.

programme.title: Tea With Mussolini
programme.desc: A young Italian boy is taken in by an Englishwoman and her group of eccentric friends in the middle of World War II.

programme.title: Namu, the Killer Whale
programme.desc: After fishermen off the coast of Washington state slay a killer whale, the dead animal's mate founders in the coastal waters. Marine biologist Hank Donner (Robert Lansing) finds the surviving whale and forges a bond with the animal while documenting his scientific observations. Though some believe killer whales are vicious, local woman Kate Rand (Lee Meriwether) and her young daughter, Lisa (Robin Mattson), warm to Hank's new pal, even as fishermen state their plans to kill the whale.

programme.title: Two for the Seesaw
programme.desc: After leaving his wife, lawyer Jerry Ryan (Robert Mitchum) moves from Omaha, Neb., to New York City to start a new life. While studying for the New York Bar Examination and working to finalize his divorce, Ryan meets dancer Gittel Mosca (Shirley MacLaine), and the two begin a cautious courtship. However, Ryan feels that he must come to terms with his failed marriage and overcome his lingering attachment to his ex-wife before he can redefine himself and embrace his budding romance.

programme.title: An Infinite Tenderness
programme.desc: Two physically impaired children form a close connection to each other.

programme.title: Romeo and Juliet
programme.desc: In this classic Shakespearean story, long-time adversarial families the Capulets and the Montagues engage in a street brawl, which results in a decree declaring that the next conflict will be punishable by death. But during an opulent masked ball, young Romeo Montague (Laurence Harvey) falls in love with Juliet Capulet (Susan Shentall). With the family feud reignited, Juliet's cousin kills Romeo's friend, Mercutio (Ubaldo Zollo), placing the young lovers in grave danger.

programme.title: The Coca-Cola Kid
programme.desc: Becker (Eric Roberts) is an American marketing expert working for the Coca-Cola Company. He is extremely dedicated to his work and travels the world pushing the product on as many places as he can. When he realizes that there is a part of Australia where absolutely nobody buys Coke, he vows to change that. But then he meets not only McDowell (Bill Kerr), a local entrepreneur who manufactures his own soda, but McDowell's beautiful daughter, Terri (Greta Scacchi), and everything changes.

programme.title: Pocketful of Miracles
programme.desc: Beggar Apple Annie (Bette Davis) learns that her daughter, escorted by an aristocratic suitor, plans to visit. It's great news -- except that she has tricked her daughter into believing she is a wealthy socialite. Fearing her true identity will disappoint, Annie petitions a superstitious mobster (Glenn Ford), who thinks the apples she sells are lucky, for help. Hesitant at first, the mafioso is persuaded by his girlfriend (Hope Lange) to disguise Annie, if only long enough to fool her daughter.

programme.title: Allotment Wives
programme.desc: An Army officer investigates a bigamy racket in which scheming women marry soldiers to collect their government checks.

programme.title: The Clown and the Kid
programme.desc: A clown's (Don Keefer) orphaned son (Mike McGreevey) unwittingly helps a convict (John Lupton) escape police with his father's makeup.

programme.title: Namu, the Killer Whale

With the family feud reignited, Juliet's cousin kills Romeo's friend, Mercutio (Ubaldo Zollo), placing the young lovers in grave danger.

programme.title: The Night They Raided Minsky's
programme.desc: To distance herself from her strict Amish family, naïve Rachel Schpitendavel escapes to New York City to become a dancer. While Rachel's dances based on Biblical stories are too innocent for Minsky's Burlesque House, club-owner Billy Minsky plans on using Rachel's routine to humiliate critics of his business. But trouble arises when partners in a comedy duo compete for Rachel's affections.

programme.title: Three in the Attic
programme.desc: A campus swinger (Christopher Jones) keeps three girlfriends in the dark; they catch on and try to exhaust him.

programme.title: Madhouse
programme.desc: The career of horror icon Paul Toombes (Vincent Price) ends in scandal when his fiancée dies under mysterious circumstances. Freed from the mental hospital where he had been committed, the recovered Toombes and screenwriter Herbert Flay (Peter Cushing) intend to revive his most popular character, Dr. Death, for a television series. But the dead bodies start piling up -- all of them killed in ways that mimic the victims in Toombes' films -- and to clear his name he must find the real killer.

programme.title: The Masque of the Red Death
programme.desc: A tyrannical 12th-century prince is intrigued by a girl and takes her to live amid the immorality of his court.

programme.title: The Haunted Palace
programme.desc: Condemned warlock Joseph Curwen (Vincent Price) curses a New England village just before being burned alive. More than a century later, Curwen's kindly great-great grandson Charles Ward (also Price) arrives in town and moves into Curwen's old mansion. Caretaker Simon Orne (Lon Chaney Jr.) helps Charles and his wife Ann (Debra Paget) adjust to their new home. The ancient curse, however, takes hold of Joseph, awakening inside him a long-dormant evil passed on through blood.

programme.title: Tower of London
programme.desc: In 15th-century England, Richard III (Vincent Price) desperately wants the throne, but his ailing brother, King Edward IV (Justice Watson), instead bestows it upon his other sibling, Clarence (Richard McCauly). This sends Richard into a homicidal rage, resulting in Clarence's murder and the deaths and torture of many others who could keep the crown from the crazed man. But as the mayhem continues, Richard's sanity slips, and the ghosts of the murdered men begin to haunt the beleaguered royal.

programme.title: The Gravedancers
programme.desc: After a funeral, several college friends reunite in a cemetery and reminisce about the former life of the deceased. The celebration starts to go too far after they get drunk and begin dancing on graves, and as a result, each of them becomes haunted by malevolent spirits.

programme.title: Diary of a Madman
programme.desc: When Judge Simon Cordier (Vincent Price) goes to see Louis Girot (Harvey Stephens), a prisoner he sentenced to death, the criminal insists he is not guilty and that he is inhabited by an evil spirit. Cordier dismisses Girot's claims, but he becomes unnerved when Girot lights himself on fire to supposedly end the demonic possession. After the visit, Cordier, beset by insomnia, begins to have odd visions and starts to wonder if Girot might have been telling the truth after all.

programme.title: Donovan's Brain
programme.desc: Valiant scientist Dr. Cory (Lew Ayres) knows he must resort to unorthodox methods in order to save ailing tycoon Tom Donovan, so the surgeon removes the wealthy man's brain and manages to keep it functioning with electrical stimulation. Unfortunately, it isn't long before Donovan's brain somehow possesses the kindhearted Dr. Cory, who then begins to behave like the heartless Donovan. Cory's wife, Janice (Nancy Davis), and friend Dr. Schratt (Gene Evans) try to intervene, with horrific results.

programme.title: The Monster That Challenged the World
programme.desc: An earthquake doesn't just shake up Southern California -- it awakens a nest of monsters lurking in the Salton Sea. These bloodthirsty sea snails are gobbling up anyone who sets foot in the water. And when the creatures move on to land in search of wider hunting grounds, they launch a reign of terror that threatens to spread across the whole country. Humanity's only hope rests on a crew of intrepid scientists and Lt. Cmdr. John Twillinger (Tim Holt).

programme.title: The Fall of the House of Usher
programme.desc: Based on the classic story "The Fall of the House of Usher" by Edgar Allan Poe and directed by legendary filmmaker Roger Corman, this thriller features Vincent Price as Roderick Usher, a man who believes his family to be cursed by incurable madness. So sure is he of his family's doom, that when his sister Madeline (Myrna Fahey) announces her engagement to Philip Winthrop (Mark Damon), Roderick will stop at nothing to prevent their marriage and keep the Usher bloodline from continuing.

programme.title: The Oblong Box
programme.desc: Julian (Vincent Price) hides his horrendously disfigured brother, Sir Edward Markham (Alister Williamson), in a tower where he is kept in chains. Anxious for freedom, Edward fakes his death with the aid of an immoral attorney, Trench (Peter Arne), and a pill that puts him into a catatonic state. But the escape plan takes a treacherous turn when Julian unwittingly buries his brother alive -- and he's later unearthed by grave robbers under the employ of malevolent Dr. Neuhardt (Christopher Lee).

programme.title: Salt and Pepper
programme.desc: Christopher Pepper (Peter Lawford) and Charles Salt (Sammy Davis Jr.) are hip Soho nightclub owners enjoying the good life -- until a secret agent turns up dead in their club. They find her diary and, pursuing the case on their own, discover a sinister plot to overthrow the British government, masterminded by a certain Col. Woodstock (John Le Mesurier). Salt and Pepper have a tough time getting anyone to believe their story until Col. Balsom (Ernest Clark) of MI5 hires them to foil the plot.

programme.title: Cul-de-Sac
programme.desc: When on-the-lam crook Richard (Lionel Stander) and his injured partner-in-crime, Albie (Jack MacGowran), seek shelter in a remote castle by the sea, they find themselves confronted by the owners -- George (Donald Pleasence), an eccentric and weak retiree, and his oversexed wife, Teresa (Françoise Dorléac). Richard seizes control of the castle, but, as the criminals are pulled further into the isolated world of the strange couple, a volatile test of wills ensues.

programme.title: Penitentiary
programme.desc: Hitchhiker Martel "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) gets a lift from prostitute Linda (Hazel Spears) in her van and travels with her to meet her clients. After a fight breaks out with the men, Gordone is knocked unconscious and awakens to find he has been wrongly charged with murder. As a way to protect himself in prison, Gordone starts fighting other inmates. This leads him to discover an underground boxing tournament, with the top prize being a prison release.

programme.title: Penitentiary II
programme.desc: Boxer "Too Sweet" Gordone (Leon Isaac Kennedy) tries keeping his nose clean after being paroled from prison. He could box, but he doesn't want to go back to that life. He works as a deliveryman instead, and starts seeing his old girlfriend, Clarisse (Eugenia Wright). But a psychotic criminal, Half Dead (Ernie Hudson), who was Gordone's enemy in prison, breaks out and kills Clarisse as payback. The murder forces Gordone back into the ring, and he is desperate to get revenge against Half Dead.

programme.title: The Wilby Conspiracy
programme.desc: English engineer Jim Keogh (Michael Caine) and black anti-apartheid activist Shack Twala (Sidney Poitier) go on the run together in the 1970s South Africa after falling foul of the police. Aided by Shack's lawyer, Rina (Prunella Gee), the two attempt to make their way to Cape Town where Shack hopes to return a diamond stash to the African National Congress and in turn seek help from the Congress' leader, Wilby (Joe De Graft). Unbeknownst to the pair, they are being followed.

programme.title: I Escaped From Devil's Island
programme.desc: A convicted murderer leads a band of men through shark-infested waters in an attempt to escape the fortress prison.

programme.title: The Defiant Ones
programme.desc: Two men (Robert Urich, Carl Weathers) of different races, who loathe each other, escape from a chain gang shackled together.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman (Fred Williamson) returns home to Gary, Ind., when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake (Jim Brown) and Laurie (Pam Grier), the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Eve of Destruction
programme.desc: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

programme.title: A Dog's Best Friend
programme.desc: Married ranchers (Bill Williams, Marcia Henderson) take in an ungrateful boy (Roger Mobley) who befriends a slain hermit's German shepherd.

programme.title: Man From Del Rio
programme.desc: Thanks to his prowess with a gun, Dave Robles (Anthony Quinn) makes a place for himself in Mesa, becoming sheriff after out-dueling several gunfighters in a single day. But Robles, a Mexican, seethes over the town's racism, and is warned by kindly nurse Estella (Katy Jurado) that without his gun, he would not last very long. That theory is put to the test when the new sheriff injures his wrist fighting with Ed Bannister (Peter Whitney), who upon learning about it, challenges Robles to a duel.

programme.title: Oklahoma Territory
programme.desc: Amid conflicts between the Cherokee tribe and Oklahoma's white settlers, the tribe's chief, Buffalo Horn (Ted de Corsia), is framed for murder. District Attorney Temple Houston (Bill Williams) must put aside his friendship with the chief and budding romance with the chief's daughter, Ruth Red Hawk (Gloria Talbott), to prosecute the case. Although Buffalo Horn has a solid alibi for the time of the killing, the political and business corruption of the territory makes a fair trial difficult.

programme.title: Wanda Nevada
programme.desc: In the American Southwest of the 1950s, middle-aged vagabond Beaudray Demerille (Peter Fonda) survives as a cardsharp who moves from town to town. But his latest victory brings him unwanted spoils in the form of Wanda Nevada (Brooke Shields), a fiery 13-year-old. At first Beaudray does everything he can to ditch Wanda -- until the girl chances upon a treasure map. But Wanda and Beaudray aren't the only ones after the loot, and they must contend with a ruthless pair of crooks.

programme.title: The Broken Star
programme.desc: Deputy Marshal Frank Smeed (Howard Duff) guns down an innocent Mexican who was about to deliver a huge sum of gold to a land tycoon, then makes off with the loot and covers his tracks by claiming that the man he shot was a dangerous criminal. Deputy Marshal Bill Gantry (Bill Williams) is charged with investigating the matter to ensure that his close friend Smeed was in the right. When he gets too close to discovering the truth, the crooked deputy tries to make Gantry his next victim.

programme.title: Fort Massacre
programme.desc: After his cavalry company is decimated by an Apache attack, Vinson (Joel McCrea) takes charge and tries to lead his remaining men to safety. Unfortunately, his pathological hatred of Native Americans causes him to commit rash acts that put his troops in jeopardy. The enlisted men, especially the rebellious McGurney (Forrest Tucker), question Vinson's leadership and even his morality, but the soldiers must stick together if they wish to make it through Apache lands.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: Bat and Lorna Adams race to Austin, Texas, with evidence that will save a man from the gallows, but bandits steal the horses from their stagecoach and Bat must find new transportation.

programme.title: Bat Masterson
programme.desc: Bat's tailor, a political organizer in a New Mexico town, draws the ire of a casino owner who kidnaps the tailor when he tries to organize an effort to fight the crooked owner's gang.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: After receiving a gunshot wound while running from Hollister's posse, a bank robber seeks medical attention and shelter.

programme.title: Tombstone Territory
programme.desc: The townspeople are angry about escalating crime and criminals being set free by the court.

programme.title: Davy Crockett, Indian Scout
programme.desc: During the 1840s, a wagon train is headed west with Davy Crockett (George Montgomery), a young man who shares a name with his famous frontiersman uncle, acting as one of the train's Native American scouts. After the passengers narrowly survive a series of ambushes from Native Americans, they come to believe that a spy is on board, helping plot the attacks. Suspicions fall on Davy's innocent partner, Red Hawk (Philip Reed), so he and Davy set out to find the real culprit.

programme.title: Drango
programme.desc: With the Civil War still a fresh memory, Maj. Clint Drango (Jeff Chandler) of the Union Army must restore order to Kennesaw Pass, Georgia. However, even with the trusty Capt. Marc Banning (John Lupton) along, he faces a distrustful town, as well as former Confederates led by the manipulative Clay Allen (Ronald Howard). A high-stakes battle of wills ensues as Drango, who hides a dark secret related to the town, must win the people's support to prevent the Union Army from intervening.

programme.title: Powderkeg
programme.desc: A pair of trouble-shooting investigators must help recover a hijacked train that has 73 hostages aboard.

programme.title: Molly's Game
programme.desc: The true story of Molly Bloom, a beautiful, young, Olympic-class skier who ran the world's most exclusive high-stakes poker game for a decade before being arrested in the middle of the night by 17 FBI agents wielding automatic weapons. Her players included Hollywood royalty, sports stars, business titans and finally, unbeknown to her, the Russian mob. Her only ally was her criminal defense lawyer Charlie Jaffey, who learned there was much more to Molly than the tabloids led people to believe.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: In the mid-1970s, charismatic English playboy James Hunt (Chris Hemsworth) and Austrian perfectionist Niki Lauda (Daniel Brühl) share an intense rivalry in Formula 1 racing. Driving vehicles that are little more than gas-filled, rolling bombs, Hunt and Lauda burn up the track, all the while pushing themselves to the breaking point of physical and mental endurance. Meanwhile, the women (Olivia Wilde, Alexandra Maria Lara) in their lives can only watch as both drivers risk death with every lap.

programme.title: Frank Miller's Sin City: A Dame to Kill For
programme.desc: The damaged denizens of Sin City return for another round of stories from the mind of Frank Miller. In "Just Another Saturday Night," Marv (Mickey Rourke) struggles to recall a nasty run-in with some frat boys. In "A Dame to Kill For," Dwight McCarthy (Josh Brolin) forsakes his battle with his inner demons to help Ava Lord (Eva Green), the woman of his dreams and nightmares. In "Nancy's Last Dance," Nancy Callahan (Jessica Alba), mad with grief and rage over Hartigan's death, vows revenge.

programme.title: Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back
programme.desc: When Jay and Silent Bob learn that a Bluntman and Chronic movie is being made featuring their comic book counterparts, they drool at the thought of fat movie checks rolling in. But when the pair find that there won't be any royalties coming their way, they set out to sabotage the flick at all costs.

programme.title: Paycheck
programme.desc: Michael Jennings is a top-notch reverse engineer. Corporations pay him to crack the secrets of their competitors' products. When the job is done, he has his memory of it erased. Rethrick, head of a company called Allcom, hires Jennings to reverse-engineer a secret government device. After the job, Jennings wakes from the memory erasure to find himself being chased by various agencies. He soon realizes that the fate of the entire world may be in his hands.

programme.title: Florence Foster Jenkins
programme.desc: In the 1940s, New York socialite Florence Foster Jenkins (Meryl Streep) dreams of becoming a great opera singer. Unfortunately, her ambition far exceeds her talent. The voice Florence hears in her head is beautiful, but to everyone else it is quite lousy. Her husband St. Clair goes to extreme lengths to make sure his wife never finds out how awful she truly is. When Florence announces her plans for a concert at Carnegie Hall, St. Clair soon realizes that he's facing his greatest challenge yet.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother.

programme.title: The Aviator
programme.desc: Billionaire and aviation tycoon Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) is a successful public figure: a director of big-budget Hollywood films such as "Hell's Angels," a passionate lover of Hollywood leading ladies Katharine Hepburn (Cate Blanchett) and Ava Gardner (Kate Beckinsale), and an aviation pioneer who helps build TWA into a major airline. But in private, Hughes remains tormented, suffering from paralyzing phobias and depression. The higher he rises, the farther has to fall.

programme.title: Day of the Fight
programme.desc: On the day of his first fight since his release from prison, a former boxing champion reconnects with his trainer, ex-wife, childhood friend, and abusive father in a quest for forgiveness and closure.

programme.title: Hotel Artemis
programme.desc: As rioting rocks Los Angeles in the year 2028, disgruntled thieves make their way to Hotel Artemis -- a 13-story, members-only hospital for criminals. It's operated by the Nurse, a no-nonsense, high-tech healer who already has her hands full with a French assassin, an arms dealer and an injured cop. As the violence of the night continues, the Nurse must decide whether to break her own rules and confront what she's worked so hard to avoid.

programme.title: Old Guy
programme.desc: An aging hit man must train a young prodigy when his employer moves to replace the old guard. However, when they learn they're being betrayed, the unlikely pair turns into a lethal team -- with their double-crossing bosses in their sights.

programme.title: The Quiet American
programme.desc: From the classic novel by Graham Greene comes a murder mystery centered on a love triangle set against the French Indochina War in Vietnam, circa 1952. It's the story of a veteran English journalist (Michael Caine), a young American (Brendan Fraser), and a beautiful Vietnamese woman caught between them. This is a world where nothing is what it seems -- suffused with opium, intrigue, and betrayal.
